file.content:
name: release
run-name: "${{ format('release {0}{1}', inputs.bump, inputs.version) }}"

# Builds are separated from signing and publishing.
# - build-* jobs run repository code (`bun run build`, `bun run pack`) with no environment, secrets or id-token.
# - sign-* and publish-* jobs run in the release environment, check out only .github/release/, and run those
#   scripts on verified artifacts, which they treat as data. They never execute repository code.
# - sign-* and publish-* jobs read their secrets from AWS Secrets Manager: they assume
#   arn:aws:iam::604439173067:role/github/opencode-release over GitHub OIDC in the release environment. The Azure
#   trusted signing ids are repository variables.
# - publish-cli and publish-desktop upload to R2 with a 30-minute token minted by the token issuer from that role
#   (.github/release/cloudflare-token.sh), not with a long-lived Cloudflare token from Secrets Manager.
# - plan decides version, channel and npm dist-tag from the event, inputs and ref; only a dispatch with a bump or
#   version on dev reaches latest.
# .github/release/ and this file are the security boundary for releases.

on:
  push:
    branches: [beta]
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 */6 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      bump:
        description: "Bump major, minor, or patch"
        required: false
        type: choice
        options: [major, minor, patch]
      version:
        description: "Override version (optional)"
        required: false
        type: string
      release_notes:
        description: "Reviewed V2 release notes for CHANGELOG.md and the GitHub release (required with bump or version)"
        required: false
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-${{ (inputs.bump || inputs.version) && 'release' || 'build' }}
  # Beta ships only the newest commit to the team. A cancelled beta run can leave unreferenced files in R2, but only
  # publish-desktop records a release, in one request.
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.ref_name == 'beta' }}

permissions:
  contents: read

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  plan:
    if: github.repository == 'anomalyco/opencode'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.version }}
      channel: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.channel }}
      npm_tag: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.npm_tag }}
      dry_run: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.dry_run }}
      cli: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.cli }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.desktop }}
      node: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.node }}
      release: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.release }}
    steps:
      - &checkout-release
        name: Check out release scripts
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4.3.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          sparse-checkout: /.github/release/
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: plan
        name: Plan
        run: bash .github/release/plan-release.sh
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }} # reads the triggering actor's repository role for stable releases
          INPUT_BUMP: ${{ inputs.bump }}
          INPUT_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          INPUT_RELEASE_NOTES: ${{ inputs.release_notes }}

  # ---- Gate: the full check suite, before anything is published ------------------------------------------------

  # release.yml does not wait for the check-test push run on the same commit, so a stable release would publish
  # whatever that run later says. This gate runs the whole suite — unit tests on both OSes, the compiled builds and
  # the Linux browser suites — before any publish job below. Dev and beta builds skip it: check-test already
  # runs on pushes to those branches.
  verify:
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'latest'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      checks: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/check-test.yml
    with:
      release_gate: true

  # A versioned release builds from a commit with its versions and changelog on the dispatched dev commit,
  # tagged v<version>. Runs git only.
  tag:
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # Stable tags are pushed with the release deploy key, the only non-releasers actor the v* tag ruleset admits.
    environment: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'latest' && needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true' && 'release' || '' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    env: &env
      OPENCODE_VERSION: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.version }}
      OPENCODE_CHANNEL: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.channel }}
      OPENCODE_NPM_TAG: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.npm_tag }}
      OPENCODE_DRY_RUN: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.dry_run }}
    outputs:
      sha: ${{ steps.tag.outputs.sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      # Fetch the deploy key only for the tag command; checkout uses its read-only token.
      - id: aws
        name: Configure AWS credentials
        if: needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'latest' && needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true'
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@e1253824e5c10ff9df46874f81ed3ec929e19cfd # v6.3.0
        with: &release-role
          output-env-credentials: false
          output-credentials: true
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::604439173067:role/github/opencode-release
          role-session-name: opencode-${{ github.run_id }}
          aws-region: us-east-1

      - name: Check out
        if: needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'latest'
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4.3.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: tag
        name: Tag
        if: needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'latest'
        run: bash .github/release/with-secrets.sh RELEASE_TAG_KEY=opencode/release/RELEASE_TAG_KEY -- bash .github/release/tag-release.sh
        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-access-key-id }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-secret-access-key }}
          AWS_SESSION_TOKEN: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-session-token }}
          OPENCODE_RELEASE_NOTES: ${{ inputs.release_notes }}

  # ---- Build: repository code; no environment, secrets or id-token --------------------------------------------

  # Fetches the models.dev catalog once per run, so every CLI bundles the same copy.
  models-catalog:
    needs: [plan, tag]
    runs-on: blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env: *env
    steps:
      - &checkout
        name: Check out
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4.3.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.tag.outputs.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-bun
      - name: Fetch
        run: bun packages/core/script/update-models-snapshot.ts .cache/models-catalog/api.json
      - name: Upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: models-catalog
          path: .cache/models-catalog/api.json
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-cli:
    needs: [plan, tag, models-catalog]
    runs-on: blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env: *env
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-bun
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.4
      - &download-models-catalog
        name: Download models catalog
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: models-catalog
          path: .cache/models-catalog
      - name: Build
        working-directory: packages/cli
        run: bun run build && rm -rf dist/.bun
        env:
          BUN_COMPILE_RELEASE: bun-v1.4.4
          OPENCODE_MODELS_SNAPSHOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/.cache/models-catalog/api.json
          OPENCODE_RELEASE_NOTES: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'latest' && inputs.release_notes || '' }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }} # read-only; raises the rate limit for Bun release downloads
      - name: Verify bundled models catalog
        run: bun packages/cli/script/catalog-smoke.ts packages/cli/dist/cli-linux-x64/bin/opencode
        env:
          OPENCODE_MODELS_SNAPSHOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/.cache/models-catalog/api.json
      - name: Upload
        uses: ./.github/release/upload
        with:
          name: build-cli
          path: packages/cli/dist

  build-node:
    needs: [plan, tag, models-catalog]
    if: needs.plan.outputs.node == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { target: linux-arm64, host: blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404-arm }
          - { target: linux-x64, host: blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404 }
          - { target: darwin-arm64, host: blacksmith-6vcpu-macos-26 }
          - { target: windows-arm64, host: blacksmith-4vcpu-windows-2025 }
          - { target: windows-x64, host: blacksmith-4vcpu-windows-2025 }
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.host }}
    env: *env
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-bun
      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "26.4.0"
      - *download-models-catalog
      - name: Build
        working-directory: packages/cli
        run: bun run build:node
        env:
          OPENCODE_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          OPENCODE_MODELS_SNAPSHOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/.cache/models-catalog/api.json
      - name: Test
        if: matrix.target != 'windows-arm64'
        working-directory: packages/cli
        run: bun run script/service-smoke.ts --node
      - name: Verify bundled models catalog
        if: matrix.target != 'windows-arm64'
        run: bun packages/cli/script/catalog-smoke.ts "packages/cli/dist/node/cli-node-$OPENCODE_TARGET/bin/opencode2-node$EXE"
        env:
          OPENCODE_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          EXE: ${{ startsWith(matrix.target, 'windows') && '.exe' || '' }}
          OPENCODE_MODELS_SNAPSHOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/.cache/models-catalog/api.json
      - name: Upload
        uses: ./.github/release/upload
        with:
          name: build-node-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: packages/cli/dist/node

  # `bun run pack` packs every npm package into dist/npm and the Linux and Node CLI archives into dist/archives.
  # The macOS and Windows CLI packages and archives are re-packed after signing.
  build-npm:
    needs: [plan, tag, build-cli, build-node]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !failure() && needs.plan.outputs.cli == 'true' }}
    runs-on: blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env: *env
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-bun
      - &download-cli
        name: Download
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: build-cli
          path: packages/cli/dist
      - name: Download Node CLI
        if: needs.plan.outputs.node == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          pattern: build-node-*
          path: packages/cli/dist/node
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Pack
        run: rm packages/cli/dist/SHA256SUMS && bun run pack
      - name: Upload
        uses: ./.github/release/upload
        with:
          name: build-npm
          path: dist/npm
      - name: Upload archives
        uses: ./.github/release/upload
        with:
          name: build-archives
          path: dist/archives

  build-docker:
    needs: [plan, tag, build-cli]
    if: needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true'
    runs-on: blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404
    env: *env
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - *download-cli
      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@c7c53464625b32c7a7e944ae62b3e17d2b600130 # v3.7.0
      - name: Set up Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@8d2750c68a42422c14e847fe6c8ac0403b4cbd6f # v3.12.0
      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-bun
      - name: Pack
        working-directory: packages/cli
        run: bun run pack:docker
      - name: Upload
        uses: ./.github/release/upload
        with:
          name: build-docker
          path: dist/docker

  # macOS and Windows pack an unsigned app; Linux packs the final AppImage, deb and rpm.
  # Dev and beta package macOS x64 on Apple Silicon and Windows arm64 on Blacksmith for speed. electron-builder's
  # afterPack rejects a bundle whose CLI or node-pty does not match the target CPU.
  build-desktop:
    needs: [plan, tag, build-cli]
    if: needs.plan.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: darwin-x64
            host: ${{ (needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'dev' || needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'beta') && 'blacksmith-6vcpu-macos-26' || 'macos-26-intel' }}
            install: ${{ (needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'dev' || needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'beta') && '--os=darwin --cpu=*' || '--os=darwin --cpu=x64' }}
          - { target: darwin-arm64, host: blacksmith-6vcpu-macos-26, install: --os=darwin --cpu=arm64 }
          # github-hosted: blacksmith lacks the ARM64 MSVC cross-compilation toolchain
          - target: windows-arm64
            host: ${{ (needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'dev' || needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'beta') && 'blacksmith-4vcpu-windows-2025' || 'windows-2025' }}
            install: --cpu=*
          - { target: windows-x64, host: blacksmith-4vcpu-windows-2025 }
          - { target: linux-x64, host: blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404 }
          - { target: linux-arm64, host: blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404-arm }
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.host }}
    env: *env
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - *download-cli
      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-bun
        with:
          install-flags: ${{ matrix.install }}
      - name: Set up rpm
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends rpm
      # Dev and beta trade larger packages for faster packaging. fpm sets XZ_OPT for the deb and rpm level, but xz
      # still reads XZ_DEFAULTS, so it uses every CPU.
      - name: Preview packaging settings
        if: (needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'dev' || needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'beta') && runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: echo "XZ_DEFAULTS=-T0" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Build
        working-directory: packages/desktop
        run: bun run build
        env:
          OPENCODE_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096
          VITE_SENTRY_DSN: ${{ vars.WEB_SENTRY_DSN }}
          VITE_SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'latest' && 'production' || needs.plan.outputs.channel }}
          VITE_SENTRY_RELEASE: desktop@${{ needs.plan.outputs.version }}
      - name: Pack
        working-directory: packages/desktop
        timeout-minutes: 60
        run: bun run pack
        env:
          OPENCODE_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
      - name: Upload
        uses: ./.github/release/upload
        with:
          name: build-desktop-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist/desktop

  # Packs the NSIS installer around the signed app. This runs repository config, so it is a build job; the
  # installer is signed next.
  build-desktop-windows-installer:
    needs: [plan, tag, sign-windows]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !failure() && needs.plan.outputs.desktop == 'true' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: windows-arm64
            host: ${{ (needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'dev' || needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'beta') && 'blacksmith-4vcpu-windows-2025' || 'windows-2025' }}
            install: --cpu=*
          - { target: windows-x64, host: blacksmith-4vcpu-windows-2025 }
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.host }}
    env: *env
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-bun
        with:
          install-flags: ${{ matrix.install }}
      - name: Download
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: sign-desktop-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/app
      - name: Pack
        working-directory: packages/desktop
        timeout-minutes: 30
        run: bun run pack
        env:
          OPENCODE_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          OPENCODE_DESKTOP_APP: ${{ runner.temp }}/app/app
      - name: Upload
        uses: ./.github/release/upload
        with:
          name: build-desktop-windows-installer-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist/desktop

  # ---- Sign: release environment; only .github/release/ is checked out ----------------------------------------
  # Pull requests run sign and publish jobs without an environment, so steps that need a secret skip or dry-run.

  # Signs the macOS CLI; signs the desktop apps inside-out, notarizes them in one submission, staples them, and
  # only then builds the zip, dmg and .app.tar.gz from the stapled apps.
  sign-macos:
    needs: [plan, build-npm, build-desktop]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !failure() && (needs.plan.outputs.cli == 'true' || needs.plan.outputs.desktop == 'true') }}
    runs-on: macos-26
    timeout-minutes: 90
    environment: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true' && 'release' || '' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    env: *env
    outputs:
      digest: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - *checkout-release
      - name: Download
        uses: ./.github/release/download
        with:
          pattern: "{build-npm,build-desktop-darwin-*}"
      - &configure-release-role
        id: aws
        name: Configure AWS credentials
        if: needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true'
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@e1253824e5c10ff9df46874f81ed3ec929e19cfd # v6.3.0
        with: *release-role
      # The certificate has no password, which apple-actions/import-codesign-certs rejects. The sign scripts look up
      # the identity in build.keychain, and codesign finds the key through the user search list.
      - name: Import certificate
        if: needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true'
        env: &aws-step
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-access-key-id }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-secret-access-key }}
          AWS_SESSION_TOKEN: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-session-token }}
        run: bash .github/release/with-secrets.sh APPLE_SIGNING_CERTIFICATE=shared/APPLE_SIGNING_CERTIFICATE -- bash .github/release/import-certificate.sh
      - name: Sign CLI
        if: needs.plan.outputs.cli == 'true'
        run: bash .github/release/sign-cli-macos.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/build-npm" "$RUNNER_TEMP/out"
      - name: Sign desktop
        if: needs.plan.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        run: |
          bash .github/release/with-secrets.sh APPLE_NOTARY_KEY=shared/APPLE_NOTARY_KEY -- bash .github/release/sign-desktop-macos.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/out" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP"/in/build-desktop-darwin-*/opencode-desktop-mac-*.app.tar
        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-access-key-id }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-secret-access-key }}
          AWS_SESSION_TOKEN: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-session-token }}
          APPLE_NOTARY_KEY_ID: ${{ vars.APPLE_NOTARY_KEY_ID }}
          APPLE_NOTARY_ISSUER_ID: ${{ vars.APPLE_NOTARY_ISSUER_ID }}
      - id: upload
        name: Upload
        uses: ./.github/release/upload
        with:
          name: sign-macos
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/out
      - name: Delete keychain
        if: always() && needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true'
        run: |
          rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/cert.p12"
          security delete-keychain build.keychain || true

  # Signs the Windows CLI and every executable and native module of the unpacked desktop apps.
  sign-windows:
    needs: [plan, build-npm, build-desktop]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !failure() && (needs.plan.outputs.cli == 'true' || needs.plan.outputs.desktop == 'true') }}
    runs-on: windows-2025
    environment: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true' && 'release' || '' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    env: *env
    outputs:
      digest: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - *checkout-release
      - name: Download
        uses: ./.github/release/download
        with:
          pattern: "{build-npm,build-desktop-windows-*}"
      - name: Unpack
        run: bash .github/release/unpack-windows.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/in" "$RUNNER_TEMP/work"
      - &azure-login
        name: Log in to Azure
        if: needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true'
        uses: azure/login@a457da9ea143d694b1b9c7c869ebb04ebe844ef5 # v2.3.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
      - &azure-sign
        name: Sign
        if: needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true'
        uses: azure/artifact-signing-action@b443cf8ea4124818d2ea9f043cba29fc3ec47b16 # v1.2.0
        with:
          cache-dependencies: false
          endpoint: ${{ vars.AZURE_TRUSTED_SIGNING_ENDPOINT }}
          signing-account-name: ${{ vars.AZURE_TRUSTED_SIGNING_ACCOUNT_NAME }}
          certificate-profile-name: ${{ vars.AZURE_TRUSTED_SIGNING_CERTIFICATE_PROFILE }}
          files-folder: ${{ runner.temp }}\work
          files-folder-filter: exe,node
          files-folder-recurse: true
          exclude-environment-credential: true
          exclude-workload-identity-credential: true
          exclude-managed-identity-credential: true
          exclude-shared-token-cache-credential: true
          exclude-visual-studio-credential: true
          exclude-visual-studio-code-credential: true
          exclude-azure-cli-credential: false
          exclude-azure-powershell-credential: true
          exclude-azure-developer-cli-credential: true
          exclude-interactive-browser-credential: true
      - name: Repack
        run: bash .github/release/repack-windows.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/work" "$RUNNER_TEMP/out"
      - id: upload
        name: Upload
        if: needs.plan.outputs.cli == 'true'
        uses: ./.github/release/upload
        with:
          name: sign-windows
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/out
      - name: Upload arm64 app
        if: needs.plan.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        uses: ./.github/release/upload
        with:
          name: sign-desktop-windows-arm64
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/work/desktop-windows-arm64
      - name: Upload x64 app
        if: needs.plan.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        uses: ./.github/release/upload
        with:
          name: sign-desktop-windows-x64
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/work/desktop-windows-x64

  sign-desktop-windows-installer:
    needs: [plan, build-desktop-windows-installer]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !failure() && needs.plan.outputs.desktop == 'true' }}
    runs-on: windows-2025
    environment: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true' && 'release' || '' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    env: *env
    outputs:
      digest: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - *checkout-release
      - name: Download
        uses: ./.github/release/download
        with:
          pattern: build-desktop-windows-installer-*
      - name: Unpack
        run: mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/work" && cp "$RUNNER_TEMP"/in/build-desktop-windows-installer-*/*.exe "$RUNNER_TEMP/work/"
      - *azure-login
      - *azure-sign
      - name: Repack
        run: bash .github/release/repack-windows.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/work" "$RUNNER_TEMP/out"
      - id: upload
        name: Upload
        uses: ./.github/release/upload
        with:
          name: sign-desktop-windows-installer
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/work

  # ---- Publish: release environment; only .github/release/ is checked out -------------------------------------
  # Destinations, names and channels come from plan and the scripts, never from artifacts.

  # Build provenance for the npm tarballs and Linux archives. No secrets; id-token only for Sigstore.
  publish-attestations:
    needs: [plan, build-npm, verify]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !failure() && needs.plan.outputs.cli == 'true' && needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - *checkout-release
      - name: Download
        uses: ./.github/release/download
        with:
          pattern: "{build-npm,build-archives}"
      - name: Sign
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/in/build-npm/*.tgz
            ${{ runner.temp }}/in/build-archives/opencode*

  publish-npm:
    needs: [plan, sign-macos, sign-windows, publish-attestations, verify]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !failure() && needs.plan.outputs.cli == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true' && 'release' || '' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: read
    env: *env
    steps:
      - *checkout-release
      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.11.0"
      - &download-signed-cli
        name: Download
        uses: ./.github/release/download
        with:
          pattern: "{build-npm,build-archives,sign-macos,sign-windows}"
          digests: sign-macos=${{ needs.sign-macos.outputs.digest }} sign-windows=${{ needs.sign-windows.outputs.digest }}
      - name: Publish
        run: bash .github/release/publish-npm.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/build-npm" "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/sign-macos" "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/sign-windows"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  publish-cli:
    needs: [plan, sign-macos, sign-windows, publish-npm, verify]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !failure() && needs.plan.outputs.cli == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true' && 'release' || '' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    env: *env
    steps:
      - *checkout-release
      - *download-signed-cli
      - *configure-release-role
      - &cloudflare-token
        name: Cloudflare token
        id: cloudflare-token
        if: needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true'
        run: bash .github/release/cloudflare-token.sh
        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-access-key-id }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-secret-access-key }}
          AWS_SESSION_TOKEN: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-session-token }}
          CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN_URL: ${{ vars.CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN_URL }}
      - name: Publish
        run: bash .github/release/publish-cli.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/build-archives" "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/sign-macos" "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/sign-windows"
        env: &cloudflare
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: 15d29c8639fd3733b1b5486a2acfd968
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ steps.cloudflare-token.outputs.token }}

  publish-desktop:
    needs: [plan, sign-macos, sign-desktop-windows-installer, verify]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !failure() && needs.plan.outputs.desktop == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true' && 'release' || '' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    env: *env
    steps:
      - *checkout-release
      - name: Download
        uses: ./.github/release/download
        with:
          pattern: "{sign-macos,sign-desktop-windows-installer,build-desktop-linux-*}"
          digests: sign-macos=${{ needs.sign-macos.outputs.digest }} sign-desktop-windows-installer=${{ needs.sign-desktop-windows-installer.outputs.digest }}
      - *configure-release-role
      - *cloudflare-token
      - name: Publish
        run: |
          bash .github/release/publish-desktop.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/sign-macos" "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/sign-desktop-windows-installer" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/build-desktop-linux-x64" "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/build-desktop-linux-arm64"
        env: *cloudflare

  publish-docker:
    needs: [plan, build-docker, verify]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !failure() && needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true' && 'release' || '' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    env: *env
    steps:
      - *checkout-release
      - name: Download
        uses: ./.github/release/download
        with:
          pattern: build-docker
      - name: Publish
        run: bash .github/release/publish-docker.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/build-docker"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  publish-homebrew:
    needs: [plan, sign-macos, sign-windows, publish-cli, verify]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !failure() && needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true' && 'release' || '' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    env: *env
    steps:
      - *checkout-release
      - *download-signed-cli
      - *configure-release-role
      - name: Publish
        env: *aws-step
        run: bash .github/release/with-secrets.sh HOMEBREW_TAP_DEPLOY_KEY=shared/HOMEBREW_TAP_DEPLOY_KEY -- bash .github/release/publish-homebrew.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/sign-macos" "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/build-archives"

  # The AUR package installs the published npm tarballs, so it follows the npm publish.
  publish-aur:
    needs: [plan, sign-macos, sign-windows, publish-npm, verify]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !failure() && needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true' && 'release' || '' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    env: *env
    steps:
      - *checkout-release
      - *download-signed-cli
      - *configure-release-role
      - name: Publish
        env: *aws-step
        run: bash .github/release/with-secrets.sh AUR_KEY=shared/AUR_SSH_KEY -- bash .github/release/publish-aur.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/build-npm"

  # WinGet manifests as data. Submission to microsoft/winget-pkgs stays paused until the packages are accepted.
  publish-winget:
    needs: [plan, sign-windows, sign-desktop-windows-installer, verify]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !failure() && needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env: *env
    steps:
      - *checkout-release
      - name: Download
        uses: ./.github/release/download
        with:
          pattern: "{sign-windows,sign-desktop-windows-installer}"
          digests: sign-windows=${{ needs.sign-windows.outputs.digest }} sign-desktop-windows-installer=${{ needs.sign-desktop-windows-installer.outputs.digest }}
      - name: Render
        run: bash .github/release/render-winget.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/sign-windows" "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/sign-desktop-windows-installer" "$RUNNER_TEMP/out"
      - name: Upload
        uses: ./.github/release/upload
        with:
          name: publish-winget
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/out

  publish-github-release:
    needs: [plan, sign-macos, sign-windows, sign-desktop-windows-installer, publish-cli, publish-desktop, verify]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !failure() && needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true' && 'release' || '' }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env: *env
    steps:
      - *checkout-release
      - name: Download
        uses: ./.github/release/download
        with:
          pattern: "{build-archives,build-desktop-linux-*,sign-macos,sign-windows,sign-desktop-windows-installer}"
          digests: >-
            sign-macos=${{ needs.sign-macos.outputs.digest }} sign-windows=${{ needs.sign-windows.outputs.digest }}
            sign-desktop-windows-installer=${{ needs.sign-desktop-windows-installer.outputs.digest }}
      - name: Publish
        run: bash .github/release/publish-github-release.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP"/in/*
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          OPENCODE_RELEASE_NOTES: ${{ inputs.release_notes }}

  publish-discord:
    needs: [plan, publish-github-release, verify]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !failure() && needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true' && 'release' || '' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    env: *env
    steps:
      - *checkout-release
      - *configure-release-role
      - name: Publish
        run: bash .github/release/with-secrets.sh DISCORD_WEBHOOK=opencode/release/DISCORD_WEBHOOK -- bash .github/release/publish-discord.sh
        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-access-key-id }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-secret-access-key }}
          AWS_SESSION_TOKEN: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-session-token }}

    needs: [plan, tag, publish-npm, publish-cli, publish-desktop, publish-github-release, verify]

      pull-requests: write

1	name: release
2	run-name: "${{ format('release {0}{1}', inputs.bump, inputs.version) }}"
3	
4	# Builds are separated from signing and publishing.
5	# - build-* jobs run repository code (`bun run build`, `bun run pack`) with no environment, secrets or id-token.
6	# - sign-* and publish-* jobs run in the release environment, check out only .github/release/, and run those
7	#   scripts on verified artifacts, which they treat as data. They never execute repository code.
8	# - sign-* and publish-* jobs read their secrets from AWS Secrets Manager: they assume
9	#   arn:aws:iam::604439173067:role/github/opencode-release over GitHub OIDC in the release environment. The Azure
10	#   trusted signing ids are repository variables.
11	# - publish-cli and publish-desktop upload to R2 with a 30-minute token minted by the token issuer from that role
12	#   (.github/release/cloudflare-token.sh), not with a long-lived Cloudflare token from Secrets Manager.
13	# - plan decides version, channel and npm dist-tag from the event, inputs and ref; only a dispatch with a bump or
14	#   version on dev reaches latest.
15	# .github/release/ and this file are the security boundary for releases.
16	
17	on:
18	  push:
19	    branches: [beta]
20	  schedule:
21	    - cron: "17 */6 * * *"
22	  workflow_dispatch:
23	    inputs:
24	      bump:
25	        description: "Bump major, minor, or patch"
26	        required: false
27	        type: choice
28	        options: [major, minor, patch]
29	      version:
30	        description: "Override version (optional)"
31	        required: false
32	        type: string
33	      release_notes:
34	        description: "Reviewed V2 release notes for CHANGELOG.md and the GitHub release (required with bump or version)"
35	        required: false
36	        type: string
37	
38	concurrency:
39	  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-${{ (inputs.bump || inputs.version) && 'release' || 'build' }}
40	  # Beta ships only the newest commit to the team. A cancelled beta run can leave unreferenced files in R2, but only
41	  # publish-desktop records a release, in one request.
42	  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.ref_name == 'beta' }}
43	
44	permissions:
45	  contents: read
46	
47	defaults:
48	  run:
49	    shell: bash
50	
51	jobs:
52	  plan:
53	    if: github.repository == 'anomalyco/opencode'
54	    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
55	    permissions:
56	      contents: read
57	    outputs:
58	      version: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.version }}
59	      channel: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.channel }}
60	      npm_tag: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.npm_tag }}
61	      dry_run: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.dry_run }}
62	      cli: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.cli }}
63	      desktop: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.desktop }}
64	      node: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.node }}
65	      release: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.release }}
66	    steps:
67	      - &checkout-release
68	        name: Check out release scripts
69	        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4.3.1
70	        with:
71	          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
72	          sparse-checkout: /.github/release/
73	          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
74	          persist-credentials: false
75	      - id: plan
76	        name: Plan
77	        run: bash .github/release/plan-release.sh
78	        env:
79	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }} # reads the triggering actor's repository role for stable releases
80	          INPUT_BUMP: ${{ inputs.bump }}
81	          INPUT_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
82	          INPUT_RELEASE_NOTES: ${{ inputs.release_notes }}
83	
84	  # ---- Gate: the full check suite, before anything is published ------------------------------------------------
85	
86	  # release.yml does not wait for the check-test push run on the same commit, so a stable release would publish
87	  # whatever that run later says. This gate runs the whole suite — unit tests on both OSes, the compiled builds and
88	  # the Linux browser suites — before any publish job below. Dev and beta builds skip it: check-test already
89	  # runs on pushes to those branches.
90	  verify:
91	    needs: plan
92	    if: needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'latest'
93	    permissions:
94	      contents: read
95	      checks: write
96	    uses: ./.github/workflows/check-test.yml
97	    with:
98	      release_gate: true
99	
100	  # A versioned release builds from a commit with its versions and changelog on the dispatched dev commit,
101	  # tagged v<version>. Runs git only.
102	  tag:
103	    needs: plan
104	    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
105	    # Stable tags are pushed with the release deploy key, the only non-releasers actor the v* tag ruleset admits.
106	    environment: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'latest' && needs.plan.outputs.dry_run != 'true' && 'release' || '' }}
107	    permissions:
108	      contents: read
109	      id-token: write
110	    env: &env
111	      OPENCODE_VERSION: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.version }}
112	      OPENCODE_CHANNEL: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.channel }}
113	      OPENCODE_NPM_TAG: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.npm_tag }}
114	      OPENCODE_DRY_RUN: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.dry_run }}
115	    outputs:

117	    steps:
118	      # Fetch the deploy key only for the tag command; checkout uses its read-only token.
119	      - id: aws

122	        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@e1253824e5c10ff9df46874f81ed3ec929e19cfd # v6.3.0
123	        with: &release-role
124	          output-env-credentials: false
125	          output-credentials: true
126	          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::604439173067:role/github/opencode-release
127	          role-session-name: opencode-${{ github.run_id }}
128	          aws-region: us-east-1
129	
130	      - name: Check out
131	        if: needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'latest'
132	        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4.3.1
133	        with:
134	          persist-credentials: false
135	      - id: tag
136	        name: Tag
137	        if: needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'latest'
138	        run: bash .github/release/with-secrets.sh RELEASE_TAG_KEY=opencode/release/RELEASE_TAG_KEY -- bash .github/release/tag-release.sh
139	        env:
140	          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-access-key-id }}
141	          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-secret-access-key }}
142	          AWS_SESSION_TOKEN: ${{ steps.aws.outputs.aws-session-token }}
143	          OPENCODE_RELEASE_NOTES: ${{ inputs.release_notes }}
144	
145	  # ---- Build: repository code; no environment, secrets or id-token --------------------------------------------
146	
147	  # Fetches the models.dev catalog once per run, so every CLI bundles the same copy.
148	  models-catalog:
149	    needs: [plan, tag]

164	      - name: Upload

166	        with:
167	          name: models-catalog
168	          path: .cache/models-catalog/api.json
169	          if-no-files-found: error
170	
171	  build-cli:
172	    needs: [plan, tag, models-catalog]
173	    runs-on: blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404
174	    timeout-minutes: 30
175	    env: *env
176	    steps:
177	      - *checkout
178	      - name: Set up Bun
179	        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-bun
180	        with:
181	          bun-version: 1.4.4
182	      - &download-models-catalog
183	        name: Download models catalog
184	        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
185	        with:
186	          name: models-catalog
187	          path: .cache/models-catalog
188	      - name: Build
189	        working-directory: packages/cli
190	        run: bun run build && rm -rf dist/.bun
191	        env:
192	          BUN_COMPILE_RELEASE: bun-v1.4.4
193	          OPENCODE_MODELS_SNAPSHOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/.cache/models-catalog/api.json
194	          OPENCODE_RELEASE_NOTES: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'latest' && inputs.release_notes || '' }}
195	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }} # read-only; raises the rate limit for Bun release downloads
196	      - name: Verify bundled models catalog
197	        run: bun packages/cli/script/catalog-smoke.ts packages/cli/dist/cli-linux-x64/bin/opencode
198	        env:
199	          OPENCODE_MODELS_SNAPSHOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/.cache/models-catalog/api.json
200	      - name: Upload
201	        uses: ./.github/release/upload
202	        with:
203	          name: build-cli
204	          path: packages/cli/dist
205	
206	  build-node:
207	    needs: [plan, tag, models-catalog]
208	    if: needs.plan.outputs.node == 'true'
209	    strategy:
210	      fail-fast: false
211	      matrix:
212	        include:
213	          - { target: linux-arm64, host: blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404-arm }
214	          - { target: linux-x64, host: blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404 }
215	          - { target: darwin-arm64, host: blacksmith-6vcpu-macos-26 }
216	          - { target: windows-arm64, host: blacksmith-4vcpu-windows-2025 }
217	          - { target: windows-x64, host: blacksmith-4vcpu-windows-2025 }
218	    runs-on: ${{ matrix.host }}

224	      - name: Set up Node

232	        env:

235	      - name: Test

284	      - name: Upload archives

291	    needs: [plan, tag, build-cli]

298	      - name: Set up QEMU
299	        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@c7c53464625b32c7a7e944ae62b3e17d2b600130 # v3.7.0

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# validate.sh <file>: fails unless <file> has exactly the shape of nix/hashes.json, so the hashes bot can only ever publish
     3	# three SRI hashes. Used by bot-nix-hashes.yml before it commits and by check-bot-scope.yml on the bot's pull request.
     4	# Adding a system to the flake means adding it to SYSTEMS here.
     5	set -euo pipefail
     6	
     7	file=${1:?usage: validate.sh <file>}
     8	SYSTEMS='["aarch64-darwin","aarch64-linux","x86_64-linux"]'
     9	
    10	fail() {
    11	  echo "::error::$file: $*" >&2
    12	  exit 1
    13	}
    14	
    15	if [ ! -f "$file" ] || [ -L "$file" ]; then fail "not a regular file"; fi
    16	[ "$(wc -c < "$file")" -lt 4096 ] || fail "4096 bytes or larger"
    17	jq -se 'length == 1' "$file" > /dev/null 2>&1 || fail "not a single JSON value"
    18	jq -e --argjson systems "$SYSTEMS" '
    19	  type == "object"
    20	  and keys == ["nodeModules"]
    21	  and (.nodeModules | type == "object")
    22	  and (.nodeModules | keys == $systems)
    23	  and (.nodeModules | all(.[]; type == "string" and test("\\Asha256-[A-Za-z0-9+/]{43}=\\z")))
    24	' "$file" > /dev/null || fail "expected {\"nodeModules\": {<$SYSTEMS>: \"sha256-<44 base64 chars>\"}}"
    25	# The canonical form rules out duplicate keys and anything else jq would drop on parse.
    26	jq . "$file" | cmp -s - "$file" || fail "not formatted as jq . prints it"
    27	echo "$file: valid"
=== release/README.md
     1	# Deploy boundary
     2	
     3	The deploy workflows (`deploy.yml`, `deploy-site.yml`, `deploy-files.yml`,
     4	`deploy-update.yml`) split every service in two:
     5	
     6	- **build** runs repository code (`bun install`, `cf build`, `bun script/build.ts`,
     7	  `wrangler deploy --dry-run`) with no environment, no secrets, and no OIDC
     8	  token. It uploads the deploy-ready output with a `SHA256SUMS` and reports that
     9	  manifest's digest as a job output.
    10	- **deploy** runs in the `dev` or `production` environment, assumes the stage's
    11	  AWS role, mints a short-lived Cloudflare token from the token issuer
    12	  (`cloudflare-token.sh`), and checks out only `.github/release/`. It verifies
    13	  the artifact against the digest the build job reported, installs the pinned
    14	  `cf`/`wrangler` CLI (`npm ci --ignore-scripts`), and runs only a
    15	  `deploy-*.sh` script here.
    16	
    17	Repository code outside `.github/` does not need Dax's review, so the deploy job
    18	must never execute it. The scripts treat the artifact as data: Worker code and
    19	assets may change freely, but names, routes, custom domains, crons, Workflow and
    20	export names, and every binding (including service bindings to other Workers)
    21	come from `targets/`. An artifact whose resolved config is not byte-for-byte one
    22	of those pinned targets is refused before the token is used.
    23	
    24	For `cf` services the pinned target is also what `cf` reads: the script copies
    25	the target over the artifact's config after validating it. For `wrangler`
    26	services the artifact is only `index.js`; the complete `wrangler.json` is the
    27	pinned target.
    28	
    29	## Why the token can be account-wide
    30	
    31	Cloudflare has no per-Worker permission for Workflows. The data sync Worker owns
    32	a Workflow, and `PUT /accounts/<id>/workflows/<name>` needs account-wide
    33	`Workers Scripts Write`, so `Individual Workers Editor` fails that deploy.
    34	
    35	Dev and production therefore mint a token that can write any Worker on the
    36	account. That is only safe because the code holding it is this directory: one
    37	reviewed script per service, on a verified artifact, with every destination
    38	pinned in `targets/`. Do not move a deploy back into a job that runs repository
    39	code, and do not widen a script's accepted targets without review.
    40	
    41	Production keeps this token only for a Dax-approved fast-forward of `dev`; a
    42	`dev` merge cannot reach the production environment.
    43	
    44	## Production promotion notes
    45	
    46	Moving `dev` to `production` deploys the same pinned targets with the same
    47	scripts, but production holds an account-wide token and a bad deploy is live.
    48	
    49	Before promoting:
    50	
    51	1. Confirm every dev deploy job is green on the commit being promoted
    52	   (`deploy`, `deploy-site`, `deploy-files`; `deploy-update` runs on production
    53	   only).
    54	2. Diff `.github/release/targets/` against `origin/production`. Any change here
    55	   is a change to what production may deploy.
    56	3. Rollback is a fast-forward back to the previous `production` commit, which
    57	   redeploys the previous Worker code from the same pinned targets. If a target
    58	   itself changed and must be reverted, revert it with the deploy commit.
    59	4. The production deploy job runs only `.github/release/` at `github.sha`; it
    60	   does not run repo code. The build job still runs repo code, but with no
    61	   secrets and no OIDC token.

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# plan-release.sh: decides version, channel and npm dist-tag from the event, ref and dispatch inputs
     3	# (INPUT_BUMP, INPUT_VERSION) only, and writes them to $GITHUB_OUTPUT. Nothing here reads repository files.
     4	#
     5	#   schedule or dispatch on dev       -> dev      0.0.0-dev-<run>     npm tag dev, desktop
     6	#   dispatch on dev with bump/version -> latest   x.y.z               npm tag latest, releasers only, notes required
     7	#   push or dispatch on beta          -> beta     0.0.0-beta-<run>    desktop only
     8	#   pull_request                      -> pr       0.0.0-pr-<run>      everything, dry run
     9	#
    10	# Stable releases are limited to the GitHub logins listed below (case-insensitive).
    11	. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
    12	
    13	versioned=false
    14	if [ -n "${INPUT_BUMP:-}" ] || [ -n "${INPUT_VERSION:-}" ]; then versioned=true; fi
    15	case "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME:$GITHUB_REF:$versioned" in
    16	  schedule:refs/heads/dev:false | workflow_dispatch:refs/heads/dev:false) channel="dev" ;;
    17	  workflow_dispatch:refs/heads/dev:true) channel="latest" ;;
    18	  push:refs/heads/beta:false | workflow_dispatch:refs/heads/beta:false) channel="beta" ;;
    19	  pull_request:*:false) channel="pr" ;;
    20	  *) die "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME on $GITHUB_REF cannot publish (versioned: $versioned)" ;;
    21	esac
    22	
    23	if [ "$channel" = latest ] && [ -z "${INPUT_RELEASE_NOTES//[[:space:]]/}" ]; then
    24	  die "Stable releases need release notes; generate them with ./script/release.ts --print"
    25	fi
    26	
    27	if [ "$channel" = latest ]; then
    28	  actor=${GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR:-${GITHUB_ACTOR:-}}
    29	  [ -n "$actor" ] || die "Stable releases can only be started by releasers; the triggering actor is unknown"
    30	  if ! (shopt -s nocasematch; [[ "$actor" = thdxr || "$actor" = Hona || "$actor" = rekram1-node ]]); then
    31	    die "$actor is not allowed to start stable releases"
    32	  fi
    33	fi
    34	
    35	if [ "$channel" = latest ] && [ -n "${INPUT_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    36	  version=$INPUT_VERSION
    37	elif [ "$channel" = latest ]; then
    38	  current=$(curl -fsS https://registry.npmjs.org/-/package/@opencode%2fcli/dist-tags | jq -r .latest)
    39	  [[ "$current" =~ ^([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)$ ]] || die "Unexpected latest version: $current"

    42	    major) version="$((major + 1)).0.0" ;;
    43	    minor) version="$major.$((minor + 1)).0" ;;
    44	    *) version="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))" ;;
    45	  esac
    46	  if [ "$major" -lt 2 ]; then version=2.0.0; fi

    49	  if [ "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" != 1 ]; then version="$version.$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"; fi
    50	fi
    51	
    52	if [ "$channel" = latest ]; then
    53	  if ! [[ "$version" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$ ]] || [[ "$version" == 0.0.0-* ]]; then

370	    27	find_pr() {

372	    29	    --jq 'map(select(.isCrossRepository | not)) | .[0].number // empty'

381	    38	  fi

411	     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
412	     2	# validate.sh <file>: fails unless <file> has exactly the shape of nix/hashes.json, so the hashes bot can only ever publish
413	     3	# three SRI hashes. Used by bot-nix-hashes.yml before it commits and by check-bot-scope.yml on the bot's pull request.
414	     4	# Adding a system to the flake means adding it to SYSTEMS here.
415	     5	set -euo pipefail
416	     6	
417	     7	file=${1:?usage: validate.sh <file>}
418	     8	SYSTEMS='["aarch64-darwin","aarch64-linux","x86_64-linux"]'
419	     9	
420	    10	fail() {
421	    11	  echo "::error::$file: $*" >&2
422	    12	  exit 1
423	    13	}
424	    14	
425	    15	if [ ! -f "$file" ] || [ -L "$file" ]; then fail "not a regular file"; fi
426	    16	[ "$(wc -c < "$file")" -lt 4096 ] || fail "4096 bytes or larger"
427	    17	jq -se 'length == 1' "$file" > /dev/null 2>&1 || fail "not a single JSON value"
428	    18	jq -e --argjson systems "$SYSTEMS" '
429	    19	  type == "object"
430	    20	  and keys == ["nodeModules"]
431	    21	  and (.nodeModules | type == "object")
432	    22	  and (.nodeModules | keys == $systems)
433	    23	  and (.nodeModules | all(.[]; type == "string" and test("\\Asha256-[A-Za-z0-9+/]{43}=\\z")))
434	    24	' "$file" > /dev/null || fail "expected {\"nodeModules\": {<$SYSTEMS>: \"sha256-<44 base64 chars>\"}}"
435	    25	# The canonical form rules out duplicate keys and anything else jq would drop on parse.
436	    26	jq . "$file" | cmp -s - "$file" || fail "not formatted as jq . prints it"
437	    27	echo "$file: valid"
438	=== release/README.md
439	     1	# Deploy boundary
440	     2	
441	     3	The deploy workflows (`deploy.yml`, `deploy-site.yml`, `deploy-files.yml`,
442	     4	`deploy-update.yml`) split every service in two:
443	     5	
444	     6	- **build** runs repository code (`bun install`, `cf build`, `bun script/build.ts`,
445	     7	  `wrangler deploy --dry-run`) with no environment, no secrets, and no OIDC
446	     8	  token. It uploads the deploy-ready output with a `SHA256SUMS` and reports that
447	     9	  manifest's digest as a job output.
448	    10	- **deploy** runs in the `dev` or `production` environment, assumes the stage's
449	    11	  AWS role, mints a short-lived Cloudflare token from the token issuer
450	    12	  (`cloudflare-token.sh`), and checks out only `.github/release/`. It verifies
451	    13	  the artifact against the digest the build job reported, installs the pinned
452	    14	  `cf`/`wrangler` CLI (`npm ci --ignore-scripts`), and runs only a
453	    15	  `deploy-*.sh` script here.
454	    16	
455	    17	Repository code outside `.github/` does not need Dax's review, so the deploy job
456	    18	must never execute it. The scripts treat the artifact as data: Worker code and
457	    19	assets may change freely, but names, routes, custom domains, crons, Workflow and
458	    20	export names, and every binding (including service bindings to other Workers)
459	    21	come from `targets/`. An artifact whose resolved config is not byte-for-byte one
460	    22	of those pinned targets is refused before the token is used.
461	    23	
462	    24	For `cf` services the pinned target is also what `cf` reads: the script copies
463	    25	the target over the artifact's config after validating it. For `wrangler`
464	    26	services the artifact is only `index.js`; the complete `wrangler.json` is the
465	    27	pinned target.
466	    28	
467	    29	## Why the token can be account-wide
468	    30	
469	    31	Cloudflare has no per-Worker permission for Workflows. The data sync Worker owns
470	    32	a Workflow, and `PUT /accounts/<id>/workflows/<name>` needs account-wide
471	    33	`Workers Scripts Write`, so `Individual Workers Editor` fails that deploy.
472	    34	
473	    35	Dev and production therefore mint a token that can write any Worker on the
474	    36	account. That is only safe because the code holding it is this directory: one
475	    37	reviewed script per service, on a verified artifact, with every destination
476	    38	pinned in `targets/`. Do not move a deploy back into a job that runs repository
477	    39	code, and do not widen a script's accepted targets without review.
478	    40	
479	    41	Production keeps this token only for a Dax-approved fast-forward of `dev`; a
480	    42	`dev` merge cannot reach the production environment.
481	    43	
482	    44	## Production promotion notes
483	    45	
484	    46	Moving `dev` to `production` deploys the same pinned targets with the same
485	    47	scripts, but production holds an account-wide token and a bad deploy is live.
486	    48	
487	    49	Before promoting:
488	    50	
489	    51	1. Confirm every dev deploy job is green on the commit being promoted
490	    52	   (`deploy`, `deploy-site`, `deploy-files`; `deploy-update` runs on production
491	    53	   only).
492	    54	2. Diff `.github/release/targets/` against `origin/production`. Any change here
493	    55	   is a change to what production may deploy.
494	    56	3. Rollback is a fast-forward back to the previous `production` commit, which
495	    57	   redeploys the previous Worker code from the same pinned targets. If a target
496	    58	   itself changed and must be reverted, revert it with the deploy commit.
497	    59	4. The production deploy job runs only `.github/release/` at `github.sha`; it
498	    60	   does not run repo code. The build job still runs repo code, but with no
499	    61	   secrets and no OIDC token.

565	     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
566	     2	# plan-release.sh: decides version, channel and npm dist-tag from the event, ref and dispatch inputs
567	     3	# (INPUT_BUMP, INPUT_VERSION) only, and writes them to $GITHUB_OUTPUT. Nothing here reads repository files.
568	     4	#
569	     5	#   schedule or dispatch on dev       -> dev      0.0.0-dev-<run>     npm tag dev, desktop
570	     6	#   dispatch on dev with bump/version -> latest   x.y.z               npm tag latest, releasers only, notes required
571	     7	#   push or dispatch on beta          -> beta     0.0.0-beta-<run>    desktop only
572	     8	#   pull_request                      -> pr       0.0.0-pr-<run>      everything, dry run
573	     9	#
574	    10	# Stable releases are limited to the GitHub logins listed below (case-insensitive).
575	    11	. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
576	    12	
577	    13	versioned=false
578	    14	if [ -n "${INPUT_BUMP:-}" ] || [ -n "${INPUT_VERSION:-}" ]; then versioned=true; fi
579	    15	case "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME:$GITHUB_REF:$versioned" in
580	    16	  schedule:refs/heads/dev:false | workflow_dispatch:refs/heads/dev:false) channel="dev" ;;
581	    17	  workflow_dispatch:refs/heads/dev:true) channel="latest" ;;
582	    18	  push:refs/heads/beta:false | workflow_dispatch:refs/heads/beta:false) channel="beta" ;;
583	    19	  pull_request:*:false) channel="pr" ;;
584	    20	  *) die "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME on $GITHUB_REF cannot publish (versioned: $versioned)" ;;
585	    21	esac
586	    22	
587	    23	if [ "$channel" = latest ] && [ -z "${INPUT_RELEASE_NOTES//[[:space:]]/}" ]; then
588	    24	  die "Stable releases need release notes; generate them with ./script/release.ts --print"
589	    25	fi

666	=== release/verify-artifacts.sh
667	     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
668	     2	# verify-artifacts.sh <dir>: checks every artifact downloaded into <dir>/<name> against its SHA256SUMS and that it
669	     3	# holds exactly the listed files. Artifacts made by sign jobs (sign-*) must also match the manifest digest their
670	     4	# job reported (OPENCODE_DIGESTS="name=digest ..."), so an artifact replaced after that job finished is rejected.
671	     5	# Deploy jobs set OPENCODE_REQUIRE_DIGESTS=true: every artifact must match a reported digest, because the digest
672	     6	# is what ties the bytes to the build job that made them.
673	     7	. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
674	     8	
675	     9	root=$(posix "$1")
676	    10	# download-artifact unpacks a lone matching artifact straight into <dir>; put it back under its name, found by
677	    11	# its manifest's reported digest.
678	    12	if [ -f "$root/SHA256SUMS" ]; then
679	    13	  lone=$(sha256 "$root/SHA256SUMS" | cut -c1-64)
680	    14	  name=""
681	    15	  for pair in ${OPENCODE_DIGESTS:-}; do
682	    16	    if [ "${pair#*=}" = "$lone" ]; then name=${pair%%=*}; fi
683	    17	  done
684	    18	  [ -n "$name" ] || die "The downloaded artifact's SHA256SUMS does not have a reported digest"
685	    19	  staging=$(mktemp -d)
686	    20	  find "$root" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec mv {} "$staging/" \;
687	    21	  mv "$staging" "$root/$name"
688	    22	fi
689	    23	shopt -s nullglob
690	    24	for dir in "$root"/*/; do
691	    25	  name=$(basename "$dir")
692	    26	  digest=""
693	    27	  for pair in ${OPENCODE_DIGESTS:-}; do
694	    28	    if [ "${pair%%=*}" = "$name" ]; then digest=${pair#*=}; fi
695	    29	  done
696	    30	  if [ "${OPENCODE_REQUIRE_DIGESTS:-false}" = true ]; then
697	    31	    [[ "$digest" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || die "Missing digest for $name"
698	    32	  else
699	    33	    case "$name" in sign-*) [[ "$digest" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || die "Missing digest for $name" ;; esac
700	    34	  fi
701	    35	  (
702	    36	    cd "$dir"
703	    37	    if [ -n "$digest" ] && [ "$(sha256 SHA256SUMS | cut -c1-64)" != "$digest" ]; then die "SHA256SUMS digest mismatch in $name"; fi
704	    38	    sha256 -c SHA256SUMS > /dev/null || die "Checksum mismatch in $name"
705	    39	    diff <(find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS | sed 's|^\./||' | LC_ALL=C sort) <(cut -c67- SHA256SUMS | LC_ALL=C sort) ||
706	    40	      die "Unexpected files in $name"
707	    41	  )
708	    42	  echo "verified $name${digest:+ ($digest)}"
709	    43	done

711	     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
712	     2	# tag-release.sh: in a checkout of the dispatched dev commit, commits the release versions and changelog
713	     3	# (OPENCODE_RELEASE_NOTES) and pushes only the v<version> tag at it. Writes sha=<commit> to $GITHUB_OUTPUT.
714	     4	# Runs git only, with hooks disabled; no repository code.
715	     5	. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
716	     6	
717	     7	tag="v$OPENCODE_VERSION"
718	     8	if ! dry_run; then
719	     9	  umask 077
720	    10	  ssh_dir=$(mktemp -d)
721	    11	  trap 'rm -rf "$ssh_dir"' EXIT
722	    12	  printf '%s\n' "$RELEASE_TAG_KEY" > "$ssh_dir/key"
723	    13	  unset RELEASE_TAG_KEY
724	    14	  echo 'github.com ssh-ed25519 REDACTED' > "$ssh_dir/known_hosts"
725	    15	  export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -i $ssh_dir/key -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=$ssh_dir/known_hosts"
726	    16	  git remote set-url origin git@github.com:anomalyco/opencode.git
727	    17	fi
728	    18	# @opencode/pty is versioned separately, by process-daemon-v<version> tags.
729	    19	git ls-files -z -- '*package.json' bun.lock ':!packages/process-daemon/**' | xargs -0 sed -i -E "s/\"version\": \"[^\"]+\"/\"version\": \"$OPENCODE_VERSION\"/g"
730	    20	
731	    21	if [ -n "${OPENCODE_RELEASE_NOTES:-}" ] && ! grep -qF -x "## $tag" CHANGELOG.md && ! grep -qF "## $tag " CHANGELOG.md; then
732	    22	  notes=$(mktemp)
733	    23	  printf '%s\n' "$OPENCODE_RELEASE_NOTES" > "$notes"
734	    24	  awk -v entry="## $tag — $(date -u +%F)" -v notes="$notes" '
735	    25	    function emit() { print entry; print ""; while ((getline line < notes) > 0) print line; print ""; done = 1 }
736	    26	    !done && /^## / { emit() }
737	    27	    { print }
738	    28	    END { if (!done) { print ""; emit() } }
739	    29	  ' CHANGELOG.md > "$notes.md"
740	    30	  mv "$notes.md" CHANGELOG.md
741	    31	fi
742	    32	
743	    33	if git diff --name-only | grep -vE '(^|/)package\.json$|^bun\.lock$|^CHANGELOG\.md$'; then
744	    34	  die "The release commit may only change versions and the changelog"
745	    35	fi
746	    36	
747	    37	git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null \
748	    38	  -c user.name="github-actions[bot]" \
749	    39	  -c user.email="41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com" \
750	    40	  commit --no-verify -q -am "release: $tag"
751	    41	
752	    42	# A rerun reuses the tag when it holds the same tree.
753	    43	existing=$(git ls-remote origin "refs/tags/$tag" | cut -f1)
754	    44	if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
755	    45	  git fetch -q --depth=1 origin "refs/tags/$tag"
756	    46	  [ "$(git rev-parse "$existing^{tree}")" = "$(git rev-parse "HEAD^{tree}")" ] || die "Tag $tag already exists with different contents"
757	    47	  echo "sha=$existing" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
758	    48	  exit 0
759	    49	fi
760	    50	if ! dry_run; then git push -q origin "HEAD:refs/tags/$tag"; fi
761	    51	echo "sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

763	     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
764	     2	# publish-npm.sh <build-npm dir> <signed dir>...: publishes every release tarball to npm with OPENCODE_NPM_TAG.
765	     3	# Names, the version and the package set come from this script, never from the tarballs: each tarball's
766	     4	# package.json is read as data and must match. macOS and Windows CLI packages must come from a signed dir.
767	     5	. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
768	     6	
769	     7	npm_dir=$1
770	     8	shift
771	     9	targets="linux-arm64 linux-x64 linux-x64-baseline linux-arm64-musl linux-x64-musl linux-x64-baseline-musl darwin-arm64 darwin-x64 darwin-x64-baseline windows-arm64 windows-x64 windows-x64-baseline"
772	    10	expected="@opencode/cli"
773	    11	for target in $targets; do expected="$expected @opencode/cli-$target"; done
774	    12	for lib in schema codemode theme ai util protocol client plugin plugin-browser core simulation server sdk ui; do expected="$expected @opencode/$lib"; done
775	    13	if [ "$OPENCODE_CHANNEL" != latest ]; then
776	    14	  expected="$expected @opencode/cli-node"
777	    15	  for target in linux-arm64 linux-x64 darwin-arm64 windows-arm64 windows-x64; do expected="$expected @opencode/cli-node-$target"; done
778	    16	fi
779	    17	
780	    18	if ! dry_run; then
781	    19	  for file in "$npm_dir"/*.tgz; do
782	    20	    gh attestation verify "$file" --repo anomalyco/opencode --signer-workflow anomalyco/opencode/.github/workflows/release.yml > /dev/null
783	    21	  done
784	    22	fi
785	    23	
786	    24	shopt -s nullglob
787	    25	files=()
788	    26	for dir in "$@"; do files+=("$dir"/*.tgz); done
789	    27	files+=("$npm_dir"/*.tgz)
790	    28	list=$(mktemp)
791	    29	for file in "${files[@]}"; do
792	    30	  IFS=$'\t' read -r name version config install < <(tar -xzOf "$file" package/package.json |
793	    31	    jq -r '[.name, .version, ((.publishConfig // {}) | keys - ["access"] | length > 0),
794	    32	      ((.scripts // {}) | (has("preinstall") or has("install") or has("postinstall")))] | @tsv')
795	    33	  # shellcheck disable=SC2086 # $expected is a word list
796	    34	  printf '%s\n' $expected | grep -qxF -- "$name" || die "Unexpected package $name in $file"
797	    35	  # The signed copy of a macOS or Windows CLI package replaces the unsigned one from the build.
798	    36	  if cut -f1 "$list" | grep -qxF -- "$name"; then continue; fi
799	    37	  case "$name:$file" in
800	    38	    @opencode/cli-darwin-*:"$npm_dir"/* | @opencode/cli-windows-*:"$npm_dir"/*) die "$name is not signed" ;;
801	    39	  esac
802	    40	  [ "$version" = "$OPENCODE_VERSION" ] || die "$name has version $version, expected $OPENCODE_VERSION"
803	    41	  [ "$config" = false ] || die "$name sets publishConfig beyond access"
804	    42	  [ "$install" = false ] || [ "$name" = @opencode/cli ] || [ "$name" = @opencode/cli-node ] || die "$name has an install script"
805	    43	  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$name" "$file" >> "$list"
806	    44	done
807	    45	for name in $expected; do cut -f1 "$list" | grep -qxF -- "$name" || die "Missing package $name"; done
808	    46	
809	    47	# The CLI wrappers resolve their platform packages from postinstall, so they publish last.
810	    48	packages=$(mktemp)
811	    49	wrappers=$(mktemp)
812	    50	grep -vP '^@opencode/cli(-node)?\t' "$list" > "$packages" || true
813	    51	grep -P '^@opencode/cli(-node)?\t' "$list" > "$wrappers" || true
814	    52	cat "$packages" "$wrappers"
815	    53	
816	    54	# A clean directory and config, so nothing from an artifact can redirect the registry.
817	    55	printf 'registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/\n' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/npmrc"
818	    56	export NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG="$RUNNER_TEMP/npmrc"
819	    57	cd "$(mktemp -d)"
820	    58	flags=(--tag "$OPENCODE_NPM_TAG" --access public --ignore-scripts)
821	    59	if dry_run; then flags+=(--dry-run); else flags+=(--provenance); fi
822	    60	
823	    61	publish() {
824	    62	  while IFS=$'\t' read -r name file; do
825	    63	    if ! dry_run && npm view "$name@$OPENCODE_VERSION" version > /dev/null 2>&1; then
826	    64	      echo "already published $name@$OPENCODE_VERSION"
827	    65	      continue
828	    66	    fi
829	    67	    npm publish "$file" "${flags[@]}"
830	    68	  done < "$1"
831	    69	}
832	    70	
833	    71	# npm publish returns while the registry is still processing the version: a large platform tarball can take ten
834	    72	# minutes to become available, and versions appear out of publish order. A wrapper published in that window makes
835	    73	# its postinstall fail with ETARGET, and rolling the dist-tag back does not repair an install that already failed,
836	    74	# so wait for every other package to resolve at this version before publishing the wrappers.
837	    75	wait_for_registry() {
838	    76	  if dry_run; then return; fi
839	    77	  while IFS= read -r name; do
840	    78	    for attempt in $(seq 1 180); do
841	    79	      if npm view --prefer-online "$name@$OPENCODE_VERSION" version > /dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
842	    80	      if [ "$attempt" = 180 ]; then die "$name@$OPENCODE_VERSION did not appear in the registry"; fi
843	    81	      echo "waiting for $name@$OPENCODE_VERSION"
844	    82	      sleep 10
845	    83	    done
846	    84	  done < <(cut -f1 "$1")
847	    85	}
848	    86	
849	    87	publish "$packages"
850	    88	wait_for_registry "$packages"
851	    89	publish "$wrappers"

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# publish.sh <hashes.json>: run from a checkout of dev. Puts <hashes.json> on bot/nix-hashes as one commit on top of dev,
     3	# opens or updates the pull request into dev, dispatches its required checks and enables auto-merge. Closes the pull
     4	# request instead when dev already has these hashes. Uses git, gh and jq only; never runs repository code.
     5	set -euo pipefail
     6	
     7	here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
     8	new=$(realpath "$1")
     9	branch=bot/nix-hashes
    10	file=nix/hashes.json
    11	title="chore: update nix node_modules hashes"
    12	: "${GH_REPO:?}" "${GITHUB_SHA:?}"
    13	git=(git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com')
    14	
    15	bash "$here/validate.sh" "$new"
    16	
    17	"${git[@]}" fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "+refs/heads/dev:refs/remotes/origin/dev" "$GITHUB_SHA"
    18	
    19	# A newer push that changed the inputs has its own run, which publishes hashes for it. Mirrors on.push.paths.
    20	if ! git diff --quiet "$GITHUB_SHA" origin/dev -- bun.lock package.json ':(glob)packages/*/package.json' \
    21	  ':(glob)services/*/package.json' flake.lock nix/node_modules.nix nix/scripts patches; then
    22	  echo "::notice::dev changed the hash inputs since $GITHUB_SHA; leaving it to the newer run"
    23	  exit 0
    24	fi
    25	
    26	# Only a same-repository pull request is the bot's; a fork can use the same branch name.
    27	find_pr() {
    28	  gh pr list --repo "$GH_REPO" --base dev --head "$branch" --state open --json number,isCrossRepository \
    29	    --jq 'map(select(.isCrossRepository | not)) | .[0].number // empty'
    30	}
    31	pr=$(find_pr)
    32	
    33	"${git[@]}" checkout -B "$branch" origin/dev
    34	if cmp -s "$new" "$file"; then
    35	  echo "dev already has these hashes"
    36	  if [ -n "$pr" ]; then
    37	    gh pr close "$pr" --repo "$GH_REPO" --delete-branch --comment "dev already has these hashes."
    38	  fi
    39	  exit 0
    40	fi
    41	
    42	cp "$new" "$file"
    43	bash "$here/validate.sh" "$file"
    44	"${git[@]}" add -- "$file"
    45	"${git[@]}" commit --no-verify -m "$title"
    46	[ "$(git diff --name-only origin/dev HEAD)" = "$file" ] || {
    47	  echo "::error::the commit changes more than $file" >&2
    48	  exit 1
    49	}
    50	"${git[@]}" push --no-verify --force origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$branch"
    51	
    52	if [ -z "$pr" ]; then
    53	  gh pr create --repo "$GH_REPO" --base dev --head "$branch" --title "$title" \
    54	    --body "Updates \`$file\` to the node_modules hashes computed for $GITHUB_SHA by bot-nix-hashes. check-bot-scope keeps this branch to that file."
    55	  pr=$(find_pr)
    56	fi
    57	
    58	# Pushes and pull requests made with GITHUB_TOKEN start no workflows; dispatches do. These produce the checks dev
    59	# requires on the new head.
    60	for workflow in check.yml check-test.yml check-bot-scope.yml; do
    61	  gh workflow run "$workflow" --repo "$GH_REPO" --ref "$branch"
    62	done
    63	
    64	gh pr merge "$pr" --repo "$GH_REPO" --auto --squash
    65	echo "### Nix hashes" >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY:-/dev/null}"
    66	echo "Updated pull request #$pr" >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY:-/dev/null}"

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# validate.sh <file>: fails unless <file> has exactly the shape of nix/hashes.json, so the hashes bot can only ever publish
     3	# three SRI hashes. Used by bot-nix-hashes.yml before it commits and by check-bot-scope.yml on the bot's pull request.
     4	# Adding a system to the flake means adding it to SYSTEMS here.
     5	set -euo pipefail
     6	
     7	file=${1:?usage: validate.sh <file>}
     8	SYSTEMS='["aarch64-darwin","aarch64-linux","x86_64-linux"]'
     9	
    10	fail() {
    11	  echo "::error::$file: $*" >&2
    12	  exit 1
    13	}
    14	
    15	if [ ! -f "$file" ] || [ -L "$file" ]; then fail "not a regular file"; fi
    16	[ "$(wc -c < "$file")" -lt 4096 ] || fail "4096 bytes or larger"
    17	jq -se 'length == 1' "$file" > /dev/null 2>&1 || fail "not a single JSON value"
    18	jq -e --argjson systems "$SYSTEMS" '
    19	  type == "object"
    20	  and keys == ["nodeModules"]
    21	  and (.nodeModules | type == "object")
    22	  and (.nodeModules | keys == $systems)
    23	  and (.nodeModules | all(.[]; type == "string" and test("\\Asha256-[A-Za-z0-9+/]{43}=\\z")))
    24	' "$file" > /dev/null || fail "expected {\"nodeModules\": {<$SYSTEMS>: \"sha256-<44 base64 chars>\"}}"
    25	# The canonical form rules out duplicate keys and anything else jq would drop on parse.
    26	jq . "$file" | cmp -s - "$file" || fail "not formatted as jq . prints it"
    27	echo "$file: valid"
=== release/README.md
     1	# Deploy boundary
     2	
     3	The deploy workflows (`deploy.yml`, `deploy-site.yml`, `deploy-files.yml`,
     4	`deploy-update.yml`) split every service in two:
     5	
     6	- **build** runs repository code (`bun install`, `cf build`, `bun script/build.ts`,
     7	  `wrangler deploy --dry-run`) with no environment, no secrets, and no OIDC
     8	  token. It uploads the deploy-ready output with a `SHA256SUMS` and reports that
     9	  manifest's digest as a job output.
    10	- **deploy** runs in the `dev` or `production` environment, assumes the stage's
    11	  AWS role, mints a short-lived Cloudflare token from the token issuer
    12	  (`cloudflare-token.sh`), and checks out only `.github/release/`. It verifies
    13	  the artifact against the digest the build job reported, installs the pinned
    14	  `cf`/`wrangler` CLI (`npm ci --ignore-scripts`), and runs only a
    15	  `deploy-*.sh` script here.
    16	
    17	Repository code outside `.github/` does not need Dax's review, so the deploy job
    18	must never execute it. The scripts treat the artifact as data: Worker code and
    19	assets may change freely, but names, routes, custom domains, crons, Workflow and
    20	export names, and every binding (including service bindings to other Workers)
    21	come from `targets/`. An artifact whose resolved config is not byte-for-byte one
    22	of those pinned targets is refused before the token is used.
    23	
    24	For `cf` services the pinned target is also what `cf` reads: the script copies
    25	the target over the artifact's config after validating it. For `wrangler`
    26	services the artifact is only `index.js`; the complete `wrangler.json` is the
    27	pinned target.
    28	
    29	## Why the token can be account-wide
    30	
    31	Cloudflare has no per-Worker permission for Workflows. The data sync Worker owns
    32	a Workflow, and `PUT /accounts/<id>/workflows/<name>` needs account-wide
    33	`Workers Scripts Write`, so `Individual Workers Editor` fails that deploy.
    34	
    35	Dev and production therefore mint a token that can write any Worker on the
    36	account. That is only safe because the code holding it is this directory: one
    37	reviewed script per service, on a verified artifact, with every destination
    38	pinned in `targets/`. Do not move a deploy back into a job that runs repository
    39	code, and do not widen a script's accepted targets without review.
    40	
    41	Production keeps this token only for a Dax-approved fast-forward of `dev`; a
    42	`dev` merge cannot reach the production environment.
    43	
    44	## Production promotion notes
    45	
    46	Moving `dev` to `production` deploys the same pinned targets with the same
    47	scripts, but production holds an account-wide token and a bad deploy is live.
    48	
    49	Before promoting:
    50	
    51	1. Confirm every dev deploy job is green on the commit being promoted
    52	   (`deploy`, `deploy-site`, `deploy-files`; `deploy-update` runs on production
    53	   only).
    54	2. Diff `.github/release/targets/` against `origin/production`. Any change here
    55	   is a change to what production may deploy.
    56	3. Rollback is a fast-forward back to the previous `production` commit, which
    57	   redeploys the previous Worker code from the same pinned targets. If a target
    58	   itself changed and must be reverted, revert it with the deploy commit.
    59	4. The production deploy job runs only `.github/release/` at `github.sha`; it
    60	   does not run repo code. The build job still runs repo code, but with no
    61	   secrets and no OIDC token.
