     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# plan-release.sh: decides version, channel and npm dist-tag from the event, ref and dispatch inputs
     3	# (INPUT_BUMP, INPUT_VERSION) only, and writes them to $GITHUB_OUTPUT. Nothing here reads repository files.
     4	#
     5	#   schedule or dispatch on dev       -> dev      0.0.0-dev-<run>     npm tag dev, desktop
     6	#   dispatch on dev with bump/version -> latest   x.y.z               npm tag latest, releasers only, notes required
     7	#   push or dispatch on beta          -> beta     0.0.0-beta-<run>    desktop only
     8	#   pull_request                      -> pr       0.0.0-pr-<run>      everything, dry run
     9	#
    10	# Stable releases are limited to the GitHub logins listed below (case-insensitive).
    11	. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
    12	
    13	versioned=false
    14	if [ -n "${INPUT_BUMP:-}" ] || [ -n "${INPUT_VERSION:-}" ]; then versioned=true; fi
    15	case "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME:$GITHUB_REF:$versioned" in
    16	  schedule:refs/heads/dev:false | workflow_dispatch:refs/heads/dev:false) channel="dev" ;;
    17	  workflow_dispatch:refs/heads/dev:true) channel="latest" ;;
    18	  push:refs/heads/beta:false | workflow_dispatch:refs/heads/beta:false) channel="beta" ;;
    19	  pull_request:*:false) channel="pr" ;;
    20	  *) die "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME on $GITHUB_REF cannot publish (versioned: $versioned)" ;;
    21	esac
    22	
    23	if [ "$channel" = latest ] && [ -z "${INPUT_RELEASE_NOTES//[[:space:]]/}" ]; then
    24	  die "Stable releases need release notes; generate them with ./script/release.ts --print"
    25	fi
    26	
    27	if [ "$channel" = latest ]; then
    28	  actor=${GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR:-${GITHUB_ACTOR:-}}
    29	  [ -n "$actor" ] || die "Stable releases can only be started by releasers; the triggering actor is unknown"
    30	  if ! (shopt -s nocasematch; [[ "$actor" = thdxr || "$actor" = Hona || "$actor" = rekram1-node ]]); then
    31	    die "$actor is not allowed to start stable releases"
    32	  fi
    33	fi
    34	
    35	if [ "$channel" = latest ] && [ -n "${INPUT_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    36	  version=$INPUT_VERSION
    37	elif [ "$channel" = latest ]; then
    38	  current=$(curl -fsS https://registry.npmjs.org/-/package/@opencode%2fcli/dist-tags | jq -r .latest)
    39	  [[ "$current" =~ ^([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)$ ]] || die "Unexpected latest version: $current"
    40	  major=${BASH_REMATCH[1]} minor=${BASH_REMATCH[2]} patch=${BASH_REMATCH[3]}
    41	  case "$INPUT_BUMP" in
    42	    major) version="$((major + 1)).0.0" ;;
    43	    minor) version="$major.$((minor + 1)).0" ;;
    44	    *) version="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))" ;;
    45	  esac
    46	  if [ "$major" -lt 2 ]; then version=2.0.0; fi
    47	else
    48	  version="0.0.0-$channel-$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER"
    49	  if [ "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" != 1 ]; then version="$version.$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"; fi
    50	fi
    51	
    52	if [ "$channel" = latest ]; then
    53	  if ! [[ "$version" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$ ]] || [[ "$version" == 0.0.0-* ]]; then
    54	    die "Invalid release version: $version"
    55	  fi
    56	  status=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://registry.npmjs.org/@opencode%2fcli/$version")
    57	  [ "$status" != 200 ] || die "@opencode/cli@$version is already published"
    58	fi
    59	
    60	# What each channel builds and publishes.
    61	case "$channel" in
    62	  latest) npm_tag=latest cli=true desktop=true node=false release=true ;;
    63	  dev) npm_tag=dev cli=true desktop=true node=true release=false ;;
    64	  beta) npm_tag="" cli=false desktop=true node=false release=false ;;
    65	  pr) npm_tag=pr cli=true desktop=true node=true release=true ;;
    66	esac
    67	dry_run=false
    68	if [ "$channel" = pr ]; then dry_run=true; fi
    69	
    70	{
    71	  echo "version=$version"
    72	  echo "channel=$channel"
    73	  echo "npm_tag=$npm_tag"
    74	  echo "dry_run=$dry_run"
    75	  echo "cli=$cli"
    76	  echo "desktop=$desktop"
    77	  echo "node=$node"
    78	  echo "release=$release"
    79	} | tee -a "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# Fetch only this command's named secrets; keep credentials out of its environment.
     3	. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
     4	set +x
     5	while [[ $# -gt 0 && $1 != -- ]]; do
     6	  name=${1%%=*} id=${1#*=}
     7	  [[ $name =~ ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$ && $id != "$1" && -n $id ]] || die 'Expected NAME=secret-id'
     8	  if ! dry_run; then
     9	    value=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --region us-east-1 --secret-id "$id" --query SecretString --output text)
    10	    [[ -n $value && $value != None ]] || die "Empty secret: $id"
    11	    while IFS= read -r line; do
    12	      [[ -z $line ]] || printf '::add-mask::%s\n' "${line//%/%25}"
    13	    done <<< "$value"
    14	    export "$name=$value"
    15	  fi
    16	  shift
    17	done
    18	[[ ${1:-} == -- && $# -gt 1 ]] || die 'Expected -- command'
    19	shift
    20	unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN value
    21	exec "$@"

     2	# verify-artifacts.sh <dir>: checks every artifact downloaded into <dir>/<name> against its SHA256SUMS and that it

     4	# job reported (OPENCODE_DIGESTS="name=digest ..."), so an artifact replaced after that job finished is rejected.
     5	# Deploy jobs set OPENCODE_REQUIRE_DIGESTS=true: every artifact must match a reported digest, because the digest
     6	# is what ties the bytes to the build job that made them.
     7	. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
     8	
     9	root=$(posix "$1")
    10	# download-artifact unpacks a lone matching artifact straight into <dir>; put it back under its name, found by
    11	# its manifest's reported digest.
    12	if [ -f "$root/SHA256SUMS" ]; then
    13	  lone=$(sha256 "$root/SHA256SUMS" | cut -c1-64)
    14	  name=""
    15	  for pair in ${OPENCODE_DIGESTS:-}; do
    16	    if [ "${pair#*=}" = "$lone" ]; then name=${pair%%=*}; fi
    17	  done
    18	  [ -n "$name" ] || die "The downloaded artifact's SHA256SUMS does not have a reported digest"
    19	  staging=$(mktemp -d)
    20	  find "$root" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec mv {} "$staging/" \;
    21	  mv "$staging" "$root/$name"
    22	fi
    23	shopt -s nullglob
    24	for dir in "$root"/*/; do
    25	  name=$(basename "$dir")
    26	  digest=""
    27	  for pair in ${OPENCODE_DIGESTS:-}; do
    28	    if [ "${pair%%=*}" = "$name" ]; then digest=${pair#*=}; fi
    29	  done
    30	  if [ "${OPENCODE_REQUIRE_DIGESTS:-false}" = true ]; then
    31	    [[ "$digest" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || die "Missing digest for $name"
    32	  else
    33	    case "$name" in sign-*) [[ "$digest" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || die "Missing digest for $name" ;; esac
    34	  fi
    35	  (
    36	    cd "$dir"
    37	    if [ -n "$digest" ] && [ "$(sha256 SHA256SUMS | cut -c1-64)" != "$digest" ]; then die "SHA256SUMS digest mismatch in $name"; fi
    38	    sha256 -c SHA256SUMS > /dev/null || die "Checksum mismatch in $name"
    39	    diff <(find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS | sed 's|^\./||' | LC_ALL=C sort) <(cut -c67- SHA256SUMS | LC_ALL=C sort) ||
    40	      die "Unexpected files in $name"
    41	  )
    42	  echo "verified $name${digest:+ ($digest)}"
    43	done
=== release/tag-release.sh
     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# tag-release.sh: in a checkout of the dispatched dev commit, commits the release versions and changelog
     3	# (OPENCODE_RELEASE_NOTES) and pushes only the v<version> tag at it. Writes sha=<commit> to $GITHUB_OUTPUT.
     4	# Runs git only, with hooks disabled; no repository code.
     5	. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
     6	
     7	tag="v$OPENCODE_VERSION"
     8	if ! dry_run; then
     9	  umask 077
    10	  ssh_dir=$(mktemp -d)
    11	  trap 'rm -rf "$ssh_dir"' EXIT
    12	  printf '%s\n' "$RELEASE_TAG_KEY" > "$ssh_dir/key"
    13	  unset RELEASE_TAG_KEY
    14	  echo 'github.com ssh-ed25519 REDACTED' > "$ssh_dir/known_hosts"
    15	  export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -i $ssh_dir/key -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=$ssh_dir/known_hosts"
    16	  git remote set-url origin git@github.com:anomalyco/opencode.git
    17	fi
    18	# @opencode/pty is versioned separately, by process-daemon-v<version> tags.
    19	git ls-files -z -- '*package.json' bun.lock ':!packages/process-daemon/**' | xargs -0 sed -i -E "s/\"version\": \"[^\"]+\"/\"version\": \"$OPENCODE_VERSION\"/g"
    20	
    21	if [ -n "${OPENCODE_RELEASE_NOTES:-}" ] && ! grep -qF -x "## $tag" CHANGELOG.md && ! grep -qF "## $tag " CHANGELOG.md; then
    22	  notes=$(mktemp)
    23	  printf '%s\n' "$OPENCODE_RELEASE_NOTES" > "$notes"
    24	  awk -v entry="## $tag — $(date -u +%F)" -v notes="$notes" '
    25	    function emit() { print entry; print ""; while ((getline line < notes) > 0) print line; print ""; done = 1 }
    26	    !done && /^## / { emit() }
    27	    { print }
    28	    END { if (!done) { print ""; emit() } }
    29	  ' CHANGELOG.md > "$notes.md"
    30	  mv "$notes.md" CHANGELOG.md
    31	fi
    32	
    33	if git diff --name-only | grep -vE '(^|/)package\.json$|^bun\.lock$|^CHANGELOG\.md$'; then
    34	  die "The release commit may only change versions and the changelog"
    35	fi
    36	
    37	git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null \
    38	  -c user.name="github-actions[bot]" \
    39	  -c user.email="41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com" \
    40	  commit --no-verify -q -am "release: $tag"
    41	
    42	# A rerun reuses the tag when it holds the same tree.
    43	existing=$(git ls-remote origin "refs/tags/$tag" | cut -f1)
    44	if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
    45	  git fetch -q --depth=1 origin "refs/tags/$tag"
    46	  [ "$(git rev-parse "$existing^{tree}")" = "$(git rev-parse "HEAD^{tree}")" ] || die "Tag $tag already exists with different contents"
    47	  echo "sha=$existing" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    48	  exit 0
    49	fi
    50	if ! dry_run; then git push -q origin "HEAD:refs/tags/$tag"; fi
    51	echo "sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
=== release/publish-npm.sh
     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# publish-npm.sh <build-npm dir> <signed dir>...: publishes every release tarball to npm with OPENCODE_NPM_TAG.
     3	# Names, the version and the package set come from this script, never from the tarballs: each tarball's
     4	# package.json is read as data and must match. macOS and Windows CLI packages must come from a signed dir.
     5	. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
     6	
     7	npm_dir=$1
     8	shift
     9	targets="linux-arm64 linux-x64 linux-x64-baseline linux-arm64-musl linux-x64-musl linux-x64-baseline-musl darwin-arm64 darwin-x64 darwin-x64-baseline windows-arm64 windows-x64 windows-x64-baseline"
    10	expected="@opencode/cli"
    11	for target in $targets; do expected="$expected @opencode/cli-$target"; done
    12	for lib in schema codemode theme ai util protocol client plugin plugin-browser core simulation server sdk ui; do expected="$expected @opencode/$lib"; done
    13	if [ "$OPENCODE_CHANNEL" != latest ]; then
    14	  expected="$expected @opencode/cli-node"
    15	  for target in linux-arm64 linux-x64 darwin-arm64 windows-arm64 windows-x64; do expected="$expected @opencode/cli-node-$target"; done
    16	fi
    17	
    18	if ! dry_run; then
    19	  for file in "$npm_dir"/*.tgz; do
    20	    gh attestation verify "$file" --repo anomalyco/opencode --signer-workflow anomalyco/opencode/.github/workflows/release.yml > /dev/null
    21	  done
    22	fi
    23	
    24	shopt -s nullglob
    25	files=()
    26	for dir in "$@"; do files+=("$dir"/*.tgz); done
    27	files+=("$npm_dir"/*.tgz)
    28	list=$(mktemp)
    29	for file in "${files[@]}"; do
    30	  IFS=$'\t' read -r name version config install < <(tar -xzOf "$file" package/package.json |
    31	    jq -r '[.name, .version, ((.publishConfig // {}) | keys - ["access"] | length > 0),
    32	      ((.scripts // {}) | (has("preinstall") or has("install") or has("postinstall")))] | @tsv')
    33	  # shellcheck disable=SC2086 # $expected is a word list
    34	  printf '%s\n' $expected | grep -qxF -- "$name" || die "Unexpected package $name in $file"
    35	  # The signed copy of a macOS or Windows CLI package replaces the unsigned one from the build.
    36	  if cut -f1 "$list" | grep -qxF -- "$name"; then continue; fi
    37	  case "$name:$file" in
    38	    @opencode/cli-darwin-*:"$npm_dir"/* | @opencode/cli-windows-*:"$npm_dir"/*) die "$name is not signed" ;;
    39	  esac
    40	  [ "$version" = "$OPENCODE_VERSION" ] || die "$name has version $version, expected $OPENCODE_VERSION"
    41	  [ "$config" = false ] || die "$name sets publishConfig beyond access"
    42	  [ "$install" = false ] || [ "$name" = @opencode/cli ] || [ "$name" = @opencode/cli-node ] || die "$name has an install script"
    43	  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$name" "$file" >> "$list"
    44	done
    45	for name in $expected; do cut -f1 "$list" | grep -qxF -- "$name" || die "Missing package $name"; done
    46	
    47	# The CLI wrappers resolve their platform packages from postinstall, so they publish last.
    48	packages=$(mktemp)
    49	wrappers=$(mktemp)
    50	grep -vP '^@opencode/cli(-node)?\t' "$list" > "$packages" || true
    51	grep -P '^@opencode/cli(-node)?\t' "$list" > "$wrappers" || true
    52	cat "$packages" "$wrappers"
    53	
    54	# A clean directory and config, so nothing from an artifact can redirect the registry.
    55	printf 'registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/\n' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/npmrc"
    56	export NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG="$RUNNER_TEMP/npmrc"
    57	cd "$(mktemp -d)"
    58	flags=(--tag "$OPENCODE_NPM_TAG" --access public --ignore-scripts)
    59	if dry_run; then flags+=(--dry-run); else flags+=(--provenance); fi
    60	
    61	publish() {
    62	  while IFS=$'\t' read -r name file; do
    63	    if ! dry_run && npm view "$name@$OPENCODE_VERSION" version > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    64	      echo "already published $name@$OPENCODE_VERSION"
    65	      continue
    66	    fi
    67	    npm publish "$file" "${flags[@]}"
    68	  done < "$1"
    69	}
    70	
    71	# npm publish returns while the registry is still processing the version: a large platform tarball can take ten
    72	# minutes to become available, and versions appear out of publish order. A wrapper published in that window makes
    73	# its postinstall fail with ETARGET, and rolling the dist-tag back does not repair an install that already failed,
    74	# so wait for every other package to resolve at this version before publishing the wrappers.
    75	wait_for_registry() {
    76	  if dry_run; then return; fi
    77	  while IFS= read -r name; do
    78	    for attempt in $(seq 1 180); do
    79	      if npm view --prefer-online "$name@$OPENCODE_VERSION" version > /dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
    80	      if [ "$attempt" = 180 ]; then die "$name@$OPENCODE_VERSION did not appear in the registry"; fi
    81	      echo "waiting for $name@$OPENCODE_VERSION"
    82	      sleep 10
    83	    done
    84	  done < <(cut -f1 "$1")
    85	}
    86	
    87	publish "$packages"
    88	wait_for_registry "$packages"
    89	publish "$wrappers"

file.content:
name: Process daemon release

# Publishes the opencode-pty binaries and the @opencode/pty npm packages from packages/process-daemon.
# Only process-daemon-v<version> tags publish; pull requests that touch the release pipeline build and pack
# without publishing.

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "process-daemon-v*"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/actions/prefetch-ghostty/**
      - .github/workflows/release-process-daemon.yml
      - packages/process-daemon/build.rs
      - packages/process-daemon/ghostty-revision
      - packages/process-daemon/npm/**
      - packages/process-daemon/script/npm-packages.mjs
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: packages/process-daemon

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  ZIG_VERSION: 0.16.0
  GNU_GLIBC_VERSION: "2.30"
  CARGO_ZIGBUILD_VERSION: 0.23.2

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    outputs:
      protocol: ${{ steps.protocol.outputs.protocol }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - uses: mlugg/setup-zig@8d6198c65fb0feaa111df26e6b467fea8345e46f # v2.0.5
        with:
          version: ${{ env.ZIG_VERSION }}
          use-cache: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/prefetch-ghostty
      - name: Configure baseline Zig builds
        run: |
          chmod +x "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/packages/process-daemon/script/release-bin/zig"
          echo "OPENCODE_REAL_ZIG=$(command -v zig)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/packages/process-daemon/script/release-bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Install Rust
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.90.0 --profile minimal --component clippy --component rustfmt
      - name: Read protocol version
        id: protocol
        run: |
          protocol="$(sed -nE 's/^pub const PROTOCOL_VERSION: u32 = ([0-9]+);$/\1/p' src/protocol.rs)"
          test -n "$protocol"
          echo "protocol=$protocol" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Validate tag
        run: |
          package_version="$(cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 | jq -r '.packages[] | select(.name == "opencode-pty") | .version')"
          npm_version="$(node -p 'require("./npm/package.json").version')"
          test "$package_version" = "$npm_version"
          node -e 'const pkg = require("./npm/package.json"); if (Object.values(pkg.optionalDependencies).some(version => version !== pkg.version)) process.exit(1)'
          if [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == refs/tags/* ]]; then
            [[ "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" =~ ^process-daemon-v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+([+-][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$ ]]
            test "${GITHUB_REF_NAME#process-daemon-v}" = "$package_version"
          fi
      - run: cargo fmt --check
      - run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

  build:
    needs: checks
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: ubuntu-22.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - runner: ubuntu-22.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - runner: ubuntu-22.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            musl: true
          - runner: ubuntu-22.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            musl: true
          - runner: macos-15-intel
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
          - runner: blacksmith-6vcpu-macos-15
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    env:
      PROTOCOL_VERSION: ${{ needs.checks.outputs.protocol }}
      MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: "11.0"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - uses: mlugg/setup-zig@8d6198c65fb0feaa111df26e6b467fea8345e46f # v2.0.5
        with:
          version: ${{ env.ZIG_VERSION }}
          use-cache: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/prefetch-ghostty
      - name: Configure baseline Zig builds
        run: |
          chmod +x "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/packages/process-daemon/script/release-bin/zig"
          echo "OPENCODE_REAL_ZIG=$(command -v zig)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/packages/process-daemon/script/release-bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Install musl toolchain
        if: matrix.musl
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y musl-tools
      - name: Install Rust target
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.90.0 --profile minimal --target "${{ matrix.target }}"
      - name: Install glibc baseline linker
        if: endsWith(matrix.target, '-linux-gnu')
        run: cargo install cargo-zigbuild --locked --version "$CARGO_ZIGBUILD_VERSION"
      - name: Test service
        run: cargo test --locked --target "${{ matrix.target }}" --lib --test service --test ownership
      - name: Test CLI integration
        if: runner.os != 'macOS'
        run: cargo test --locked --target "${{ matrix.target }}" --test playground
      - name: Build
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == *-linux-gnu ]]; then
            cargo zigbuild --locked --release --target "${{ matrix.target }}.$GNU_GLIBC_VERSION"
          else
            cargo build --locked --release --target "${{ matrix.target }}"
          fi
      - name: Verify glibc baseline
        if: endsWith(matrix.target, '-linux-gnu')
        run: |
          binary="target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/opencode-pty"
          required="$(readelf --version-info "$binary" | grep -oE 'GLIBC_[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+' | sed 's/GLIBC_//' | sort -V | tail -n 1)"
          echo "Highest required glibc version: $required"
          test "$(printf '%s\n' "$required" "$GNU_GLIBC_VERSION" | sort -V | tail -n 1)" = "$GNU_GLIBC_VERSION"
      - name: Smoke test
        run: |
          version="$(cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 | jq -r '.packages[] | select(.name == "opencode-pty") | .version')"
          binary="target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/opencode-pty"
          output="$("$binary" --version)"
          test "$output" = "opencode-pty $version (protocol $PROTOCOL_VERSION)"
          runtime="$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-pty-release-smoke"
          rm -rf "$runtime"
          printf 'new /bin/sh -c "printf release-smoke; sleep 1"\nwait 250\nquit\n' \
            | "$binary" play --runtime-dir "$runtime" --name smoke > "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-pty-release-smoke.log"
          grep -q 'release-smoke' "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-pty-release-smoke.log"
          grep -q 'checkpoint' "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-pty-release-smoke.log"
          test ! -e "$runtime/smoke"
      - name: Package
        run: |
          version="$(cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 | jq -r '.packages[] | select(.name == "opencode-pty") | .version')"
          name="opencode-pty-${version}-${{ matrix.target }}"
          mkdir -p "dist/$name"
          cp "target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/opencode-pty" "dist/$name/"
          cp LICENSE README.md "dist/$name/"
          tar -C dist -czf "dist/$name.tar.gz" "$name"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: opencode-pty-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: packages/process-daemon/dist/*.tar.gz
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-windows:
    needs: checks
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: windows-2025
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            arch: x64
          - runner: windows-11-arm
            target: aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
            arch: arm64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: packages/process-daemon
    env:
      PROTOCOL_VERSION: ${{ needs.checks.outputs.protocol }}
      CARGO_BUILD_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
      RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: 1.90.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
      # Portable CPU for Ghostty (see build.rs) and no Visual C++ runtime dependency.
      OPENCODE_ZIG_CPU: baseline
      RUSTFLAGS: -C target-feature=+crt-static
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - name: Enable long dependency paths
        run: git config --global core.longpaths true
      - uses: mlugg/setup-zig@8d6198c65fb0feaa111df26e6b467fea8345e46f # v2.0.5
        if: matrix.arch == 'x64'
        with:
          version: ${{ env.ZIG_VERSION }}
          use-cache: false
      # Zig 0.16 crashes when building Ghostty on the native ARM64 host, so use
      # the x64-hosted compiler there (matching check-process-daemon.yml).
      - name: Install x64 Zig for ARM64 cross-compilation
        if: matrix.arch == 'arm64'
        run: |
          $archive = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'zig-x64.zip'
          Invoke-WebRequest 'https://ziglang.org/download/0.16.0/zig-x86_64-windows-0.16.0.zip' -OutFile $archive
          if ((Get-FileHash $archive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '68659eb5f1e4eb1437a722f1dd889c5a322c9954607f5edcf337bc3684a75a7e') { throw 'Zig archive checksum mismatch' }
          Expand-Archive $archive -DestinationPath $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'zig-x86_64-windows-0.16.0' >> $env:GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Fix Zig 0.16 ARM64 function-pointer alignment
        if: matrix.arch == 'arm64'
        run: |
          $file = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'zig-x86_64-windows-0.16.0/lib/std/debug/SelfInfo/Windows.zig'
          $source = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($file)
          $old = '@ptrCast(try si.loadNtdllProc(@tagName(proc)))'
          if (!$source.Contains($old)) { throw 'Zig alignment workaround no longer matches; re-evaluate it' }
          [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($file, $source.Replace($old, '@ptrCast(@alignCast(try si.loadNtdllProc(@tagName(proc))))'))
      - name: Pin MSVC 14.51 for Zig's Clang 21
        timeout-minutes: 20
        run: |
          $installer = "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer"
          $vs = & "$installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -property installationPath
          $tools = "$vs\VC\Tools\MSVC"
          $arch = '${{ matrix.arch }}'
          $hasRuntimes = {
            (Test-Path "$($_.FullName)\lib\x64\vcruntime.lib") -and
              (Test-Path "$($_.FullName)\lib\$arch\vcruntime.lib")
          }
          if (!(Get-ChildItem $tools -Directory -Filter '14.51.*' | Where-Object $hasRuntimes)) {
            $components = '--add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.14.51.x86.x64'
            if ($arch -eq 'arm64') { $components += ' --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.14.51.ARM64' }
            $setup = Start-Process "$installer\setup.exe" -ArgumentList "modify --installPath `"$vs`" $components --quiet --norestart" -Wait -PassThru
            if ($setup.ExitCode -notin 0, 3010) { throw "VS installer exited with $($setup.ExitCode)" }
            Write-Output "MSVC 14.51 installer exited with $($setup.ExitCode) for $arch"
          }
          $toolset = Get-ChildItem $tools -Directory -Filter '14.51.*' |
            Where-Object $hasRuntimes |
            Sort-Object { [version]$_.Name } -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
          if (!$toolset) { throw "Missing MSVC 14.51 for $arch" }
          # Zig reads this file for both host and target tools on the disposable runner.
          Set-Content "$vs\VC\Auxiliary\Build\Microsoft.VCToolsVersion.default.txt" $toolset.Name -Encoding ascii
          $libc = zig libc
          $libc
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $libc -inotcontains "sys_include_dir=$($toolset.FullName)\include") { throw 'Zig selected unexpected MSVC headers' }
      - name: Install Rust toolchain and target
        run: rustup toolchain install $env:RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN --force-non-host --profile minimal --target $env:CARGO_BUILD_TARGET
      - uses: ./.github/actions/prefetch-ghostty
      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --locked --release
      - name: Smoke test
        run: |
          $metadata = cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          $version = ($metadata.packages | Where-Object name -eq 'opencode-pty').version
          $binary = "target/$env:CARGO_BUILD_TARGET/release/opencode-pty.exe"
          $output = & $binary --version
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          if ($output -ne "opencode-pty $version (protocol $env:PROTOCOL_VERSION)") { throw "Unexpected version output: $output" }
          # Start a real daemon over a named pipe; it stops when nobody claims it.
          $runtime = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'opencode-pty-release-smoke'
          $daemon = Start-Process $binary -ArgumentList @('daemon', '--runtime-dir', $runtime, '--name', 'smoke') -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(10)
          while (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $runtime 'smoke/service.json'))) {
            if ($daemon.HasExited -or (Get-Date) -gt $deadline) { throw 'daemon did not register' }
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50
          }
          if (!$daemon.WaitForExit(15000)) { $daemon.Kill(); throw 'unclaimed daemon did not stop' }
          if (Test-Path (Join-Path $runtime 'smoke')) { throw 'runtime directory was not removed' }
      - name: Package
        run: |
          $metadata = cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          $version = ($metadata.packages | Where-Object name -eq 'opencode-pty').version
          $name = "opencode-pty-$version-$env:CARGO_BUILD_TARGET"
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "dist/$name" | Out-Null
          Copy-Item "target/$env:CARGO_BUILD_TARGET/release/opencode-pty.exe" "dist/$name/"
          Copy-Item LICENSE, README.md "dist/$name/"
          tar -C dist -czf "dist/$name.tar.gz" $name
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: opencode-pty-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: packages/process-daemon/dist/*.tar.gz
          if-no-files-found: error

  package:
    needs: [checks, build, build-windows]
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    outputs:
      digest: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.digest }}
    env:
      PROTOCOL_VERSION: ${{ needs.checks.outputs.protocol }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          path: packages/process-daemon/dist
          pattern: opencode-pty-*
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Create checksums and manifest
        working-directory: packages/process-daemon/dist
        run: |
          version="$(node -p 'require("../npm/package.json").version')"
          sha256sum opencode-pty-*.tar.gz > SHA256SUMS
          artifacts='[]'
          while read -r sha256 archive; do
            target="${archive#opencode-pty-${version}-}"
            target="${target%.tar.gz}"
            artifacts="$(jq --arg target "$target" --arg archive "$archive" --arg sha256 "$sha256" '. + [{target: $target, archive: $archive, sha256: $sha256}]' <<<"$artifacts")"
          done < SHA256SUMS
          jq -n \
            --arg version "$version" \
            --argjson protocol "$PROTOCOL_VERSION" \
            --argjson artifacts "$artifacts" \
            '{schema: 1, version: $version, protocol: $protocol, artifacts: $artifacts}' \
            > release-manifest.json
          sha256sum release-manifest.json >> SHA256SUMS
      - name: Prepare npm packages
        run: node script/npm-packages.mjs dist
      - name: Validate npm packages
        run: |
          for package in dist/npm/*; do
            npm pack --dry-run "$package" >/dev/null
          done
          temporary="$(mktemp -d)"
          npm pack --pack-destination "$temporary" dist/npm/opencode-pty-linux-x64-gnu dist/npm/opencode-pty >/dev/null
          npm install --prefix "$temporary" --ignore-scripts --no-package-lock --no-audit --no-fund "$temporary"/*.tgz
          test "$("$temporary/node_modules/.bin/opencode-pty" --version)" = "opencode-pty $(node -p 'require("./npm/package.json").version') (protocol $PROTOCOL_VERSION)"

        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/bundle/github" "$RUNNER_TEMP/bundle/npm"
          cp dist/*.tar.gz dist/release-manifest.json dist/SHA256SUMS "$RUNNER_TEMP/bundle/github/"

            npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination "$RUNNER_TEMP/bundle/npm" "$(realpath "$package")"

          mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/bundle/github/SHA256SUMS" "$RUNNER_TEMP/bundle/github/checksums.txt"
      - id: upload
        uses: ./.github/release/upload
        with:
          name: process-daemon-bundle
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/bundle

  release:
    needs: [checks, package]
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/process-daemon-v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: process-daemon-release
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: .
    env:
      PROTOCOL_VERSION: ${{ needs.checks.outputs.protocol }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4.3.1
        with:
          sparse-checkout: /.github/release/
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0; caching opt-in
        with:
          node-version: '24.11.0'

        with:
          pattern: process-daemon-bundle
          digests: process-daemon-bundle=${{ needs.package.outputs.digest }}
          require-digests: 'true'
      - uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/in/process-daemon-bundle/github/*.tar.gz
            ${{ runner.temp }}/in/process-daemon-bundle/github/release-manifest.json
      # The monorepo's Latest release drives OpenCode's own update paths, so this release must never become
      # Latest. It is drafted first because immutable releases lock assets once published.
      - name: Publish release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/process-daemon-bundle/github"
          mv checksums.txt SHA256SUMS
          version="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#process-daemon-v}"
          gh release view "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
            gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --draft --verify-tag --latest=false \
              --title "process-daemon v$version" \
              --notes "opencode-pty $version (protocol $PROTOCOL_VERSION) from packages/process-daemon, published to npm as @opencode/pty@$version."
          gh release upload "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" ./*.tar.gz SHA256SUMS release-manifest.json --clobber --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          gh release edit "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --draft=false --latest=false --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
      - name: Publish npm packages
        run: bash .github/release/publish-process-daemon.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/in/process-daemon-bundle/npm"

411	     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
412	     2	# validate.sh <file>: fails unless <file> has exactly the shape of nix/hashes.json, so the hashes bot can only ever publish
413	     3	# three SRI hashes. Used by bot-nix-hashes.yml before it commits and by check-bot-scope.yml on the bot's pull request.
414	     4	# Adding a system to the flake means adding it to SYSTEMS here.
415	     5	set -euo pipefail
416	     6	
417	     7	file=${1:?usage: validate.sh <file>}
418	     8	SYSTEMS='["aarch64-darwin","aarch64-linux","x86_64-linux"]'
419	     9	
420	    10	fail() {
421	    11	  echo "::error::$file: $*" >&2
422	    12	  exit 1
423	    13	}
424	    14	
425	    15	if [ ! -f "$file" ] || [ -L "$file" ]; then fail "not a regular file"; fi
426	    16	[ "$(wc -c < "$file")" -lt 4096 ] || fail "4096 bytes or larger"
427	    17	jq -se 'length == 1' "$file" > /dev/null 2>&1 || fail "not a single JSON value"
428	    18	jq -e --argjson systems "$SYSTEMS" '
429	    19	  type == "object"
430	    20	  and keys == ["nodeModules"]
431	    21	  and (.nodeModules | type == "object")
432	    22	  and (.nodeModules | keys == $systems)
433	    23	  and (.nodeModules | all(.[]; type == "string" and test("\\Asha256-[A-Za-z0-9+/]{43}=\\z")))

436	    26	jq . "$file" | cmp -s - "$file" || fail "not formatted as jq . prints it"

438	=== release/README.md
439	     1	# Deploy boundary
440	     2	
441	     3	The deploy workflows (`deploy.yml`, `deploy-site.yml`, `deploy-files.yml`,
442	     4	`deploy-update.yml`) split every service in two:
443	     5	
444	     6	- **build** runs repository code (`bun install`, `cf build`, `bun script/build.ts`,
445	     7	  `wrangler deploy --dry-run`) with no environment, no secrets, and no OIDC
446	     8	  token. It uploads the deploy-ready output with a `SHA256SUMS` and reports that
447	     9	  manifest's digest as a job output.
448	    10	- **deploy** runs in the `dev` or `production` environment, assumes the stage's
449	    11	  AWS role, mints a short-lived Cloudflare token from the token issuer
450	    12	  (`cloudflare-token.sh`), and checks out only `.github/release/`. It verifies
451	    13	  the artifact against the digest the build job reported, installs the pinned
452	    14	  `cf`/`wrangler` CLI (`npm ci --ignore-scripts`), and runs only a
453	    15	  `deploy-*.sh` script here.
454	    16	
455	    17	Repository code outside `.github/` does not need Dax's review, so the deploy job
456	    18	must never execute it. The scripts treat the artifact as data: Worker code and
457	    19	assets may change freely, but names, routes, custom domains, crons, Workflow and
458	    20	export names, and every binding (including service bindings to other Workers)
459	    21	come from `targets/`. An artifact whose resolved config is not byte-for-byte one
460	    22	of those pinned targets is refused before the token is used.
461	    23	
462	    24	For `cf` services the pinned target is also what `cf` reads: the script copies
463	    25	the target over the artifact's config after validating it. For `wrangler`
464	    26	services the artifact is only `index.js`; the complete `wrangler.json` is the
465	    27	pinned target.
466	    28	
467	    29	## Why the token can be account-wide
468	    30	
469	    31	Cloudflare has no per-Worker permission for Workflows. The data sync Worker owns
470	    32	a Workflow, and `PUT /accounts/<id>/workflows/<name>` needs account-wide
471	    33	`Workers Scripts Write`, so `Individual Workers Editor` fails that deploy.
472	    34	
473	    35	Dev and production therefore mint a token that can write any Worker on the
474	    36	account. That is only safe because the code holding it is this directory: one
475	    37	reviewed script per service, on a verified artifact, with every destination
476	    38	pinned in `targets/`. Do not move a deploy back into a job that runs repository
477	    39	code, and do not widen a script's accepted targets without review.
478	    40	
479	    41	Production keeps this token only for a Dax-approved fast-forward of `dev`; a
480	    42	`dev` merge cannot reach the production environment.
481	    43	
482	    44	## Production promotion notes
483	    45	
484	    46	Moving `dev` to `production` deploys the same pinned targets with the same
485	    47	scripts, but production holds an account-wide token and a bad deploy is live.
486	    48	
487	    49	Before promoting:
488	    50	
489	    51	1. Confirm every dev deploy job is green on the commit being promoted
490	    52	   (`deploy`, `deploy-site`, `deploy-files`; `deploy-update` runs on production
491	    53	   only).
492	    54	2. Diff `.github/release/targets/` against `origin/production`. Any change here
493	    55	   is a change to what production may deploy.
494	    56	3. Rollback is a fast-forward back to the previous `production` commit, which
495	    57	   redeploys the previous Worker code from the same pinned targets. If a target
496	    58	   itself changed and must be reverted, revert it with the deploy commit.
497	    59	4. The production deploy job runs only `.github/release/` at `github.sha`; it
498	    60	   does not run repo code. The build job still runs repo code, but with no
499	    61	   secrets and no OIDC token.

565	     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
566	     2	# plan-release.sh: decides version, channel and npm dist-tag from the event, ref and dispatch inputs
567	     3	# (INPUT_BUMP, INPUT_VERSION) only, and writes them to $GITHUB_OUTPUT. Nothing here reads repository files.
568	     4	#
569	     5	#   schedule or dispatch on dev       -> dev      0.0.0-dev-<run>     npm tag dev, desktop
570	     6	#   dispatch on dev with bump/version -> latest   x.y.z               npm tag latest, releasers only, notes required
571	     7	#   push or dispatch on beta          -> beta     0.0.0-beta-<run>    desktop only
572	     8	#   pull_request                      -> pr       0.0.0-pr-<run>      everything, dry run
573	     9	#
574	    10	# Stable releases are limited to the GitHub logins listed below (case-insensitive).
575	    11	. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
576	    12	
577	    13	versioned=false
578	    14	if [ -n "${INPUT_BUMP:-}" ] || [ -n "${INPUT_VERSION:-}" ]; then versioned=true; fi
579	    15	case "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME:$GITHUB_REF:$versioned" in
580	    16	  schedule:refs/heads/dev:false | workflow_dispatch:refs/heads/dev:false) channel="dev" ;;
581	    17	  workflow_dispatch:refs/heads/dev:true) channel="latest" ;;
582	    18	  push:refs/heads/beta:false | workflow_dispatch:refs/heads/beta:false) channel="beta" ;;
583	    19	  pull_request:*:false) channel="pr" ;;
584	    20	  *) die "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME on $GITHUB_REF cannot publish (versioned: $versioned)" ;;
585	    21	esac
586	    22	
587	    23	if [ "$channel" = latest ] && [ -z "${INPUT_RELEASE_NOTES//[[:space:]]/}" ]; then
588	    24	  die "Stable releases need release notes; generate them with ./script/release.ts --print"
589	    25	fi
590	    26	
591	    27	if [ "$channel" = latest ]; then
592	    28	  actor=${GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR:-${GITHUB_ACTOR:-}}
593	    29	  [ -n "$actor" ] || die "Stable releases can only be started by releasers; the triggering actor is unknown"
594	    30	  if ! (shopt -s nocasematch; [[ "$actor" = thdxr || "$actor" = Hona || "$actor" = rekram1-node ]]); then
595	    31	    die "$actor is not allowed to start stable releases"
596	    32	  fi
597	    33	fi
598	    34	
599	    35	if [ "$channel" = latest ] && [ -n "${INPUT_VERSION:-}" ]; then
600	    36	  version=$INPUT_VERSION
601	    37	elif [ "$channel" = latest ]; then
602	    38	  current=$(curl -fsS https://registry.npmjs.org/-/package/@opencode%2fcli/dist-tags | jq -r .latest)
603	    39	  [[ "$current" =~ ^([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)$ ]] || die "Unexpected latest version: $current"

607	    43	    minor) version="$major.$((minor + 1)).0" ;;
608	    44	    *) version="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))" ;;
609	    45	  esac
610	    46	  if [ "$major" -lt 2 ]; then version=2.0.0; fi
611	    47	else
612	    48	  version="0.0.0-$channel-$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER"
613	    49	  if [ "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" != 1 ]; then version="$version.$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"; fi
614	    50	fi
615	    51	
616	    52	if [ "$channel" = latest ]; then
617	    53	  if ! [[ "$version" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$ ]] || [[ "$version" == 0.0.0-* ]]; then

628	    64	  beta) npm_tag="" cli=false desktop=true node=false release=false ;;

667	     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
668	     2	# verify-artifacts.sh <dir>: checks every artifact downloaded into <dir>/<name> against its SHA256SUMS and that it
669	     3	# holds exactly the listed files. Artifacts made by sign jobs (sign-*) must also match the manifest digest their
670	     4	# job reported (OPENCODE_DIGESTS="name=digest ..."), so an artifact replaced after that job finished is rejected.
671	     5	# Deploy jobs set OPENCODE_REQUIRE_DIGESTS=true: every artifact must match a reported digest, because the digest
672	     6	# is what ties the bytes to the build job that made them.
673	     7	. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
674	     8	
675	     9	root=$(posix "$1")
676	    10	# download-artifact unpacks a lone matching artifact straight into <dir>; put it back under its name, found by
677	    11	# its manifest's reported digest.
678	    12	if [ -f "$root/SHA256SUMS" ]; then
679	    13	  lone=$(sha256 "$root/SHA256SUMS" | cut -c1-64)
680	    14	  name=""
681	    15	  for pair in ${OPENCODE_DIGESTS:-}; do
682	    16	    if [ "${pair#*=}" = "$lone" ]; then name=${pair%%=*}; fi
683	    17	  done
684	    18	  [ -n "$name" ] || die "The downloaded artifact's SHA256SUMS does not have a reported digest"
685	    19	  staging=$(mktemp -d)
686	    20	  find "$root" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec mv {} "$staging/" \;
687	    21	  mv "$staging" "$root/$name"
688	    22	fi
689	    23	shopt -s nullglob
690	    24	for dir in "$root"/*/; do
691	    25	  name=$(basename "$dir")
692	    26	  digest=""
693	    27	  for pair in ${OPENCODE_DIGESTS:-}; do
694	    28	    if [ "${pair%%=*}" = "$name" ]; then digest=${pair#*=}; fi
695	    29	  done
696	    30	  if [ "${OPENCODE_REQUIRE_DIGESTS:-false}" = true ]; then
697	    31	    [[ "$digest" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || die "Missing digest for $name"
698	    32	  else
699	    33	    case "$name" in sign-*) [[ "$digest" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || die "Missing digest for $name" ;; esac
700	    34	  fi
701	    35	  (
702	    36	    cd "$dir"
703	    37	    if [ -n "$digest" ] && [ "$(sha256 SHA256SUMS | cut -c1-64)" != "$digest" ]; then die "SHA256SUMS digest mismatch in $name"; fi
704	    38	    sha256 -c SHA256SUMS > /dev/null || die "Checksum mismatch in $name"
705	    39	    diff <(find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS | sed 's|^\./||' | LC_ALL=C sort) <(cut -c67- SHA256SUMS | LC_ALL=C sort) ||
706	    40	      die "Unexpected files in $name"
707	    41	  )
708	    42	  echo "verified $name${digest:+ ($digest)}"
709	    43	done

850	    88	wait_for_registry "$packages"

name: bot-docs-locale

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - dev
    paths:
      - packages/web/src/content/docs/*.mdx

jobs:
  sync-locales:
    if: false
    #if: github.actor != 'opencode-agent[bot]'
    runs-on: blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404
    environment: release
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4.3.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.ref_name }}

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-bun

      - name: Setup git committer
        id: committer
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-git-committer
        with:
          opencode-app-id: ${{ vars.OPENCODE_APP_ID }}
          opencode-app-secret: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_APP_SECRET }}

      - name: Compute changed English docs
        id: changes
        run: |
          FILES=$(git diff --name-only "${{ github.event.before }}" "${{ github.sha }}" -- ':(glob)packages/web/src/content/docs/*.mdx' || true)
          if [ -z "$FILES" ]; then
            echo "has_changes=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "No English docs changed in push range"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "has_changes=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

content.text:
## 1. What I read

OpenCode `anomalyco/opencode@dev` at commit `bab0d0413ff31edd07b55fc499294e2e031c57d2` (committer date 2026-11-23T00:57:21Z), fetched live with `gh api`. I read all 19 workflow files, both composite actions under `.github/actions` (`setup-bun`, `prefetch-ghostty`), the two under `.github/release` (`upload`, `download`), `CODEOWNERS`, `TEAM_MEMBERS`, the PR template, both `nix-hashes` scripts, six `release/` files, `turbo.json`, root and `packages/cli` `package.json` scripts, and `packages/app/e2e/QUARANTINE.md`. The local 2026-10-31 clone was used only for `script/lint-changed.ts` and the workflow-name diff: since then `bot-docs-locale`, `deploy-changelog`, `deploy-posts`, `deploy-www` and `release-dry-run` were removed, and `check-docs` and `deploy-site` added. nexus-code was read from `origin/release/v1.3.0` at `96e96377`.

- **OpenCode:** tiered and speed-first. PRs run only affected unit tests on Linux plus typecheck; the full tier (Windows, compiled builds, Playwright) runs after merge, nightly and as a stable-release gate. Its engineering effort goes into a privilege-separated release and deploy pipeline.
- **nexus-code:** one monolithic gate. Every PR and every release-branch push runs the complete suite three times (Node 22, Node 24, and again inside the packaging job) with supply-chain gates. It is strict and reproducible but serial and slow.

Fetched copies are in `/tmp/claude-1000/-home-mike-nexus-code/43bcbb67-2cff-4fa8-a05e-f8aa598df73b/scratchpad/oc/.github`.

## 2. OpenCode workflows (all live API)

| File | Trigger | What it does | Notable technique |
|---|---|---|---|
| `check-test.yml` | push dev/beta, PR, dispatch, `workflow_call` | Unit tests, compiled-build smoke, Playwright suites | PR = Linux only, affected only; matrix built with `fromJSON`; Playwright `--shard=1/2` legs; aggregator job per OS; quarantine legs with `continue-on-error` |
| `check.yml` | push dev, PR | oxlint, `tsc`, lint of changed files | `fetch-depth: 2`, diff against `HEAD^1`; no `permissions` block |
| `check-process-daemon.yml` | PR/push with `paths:` | Rust: Miri, fmt, clippy, tests on Linux, macOS, Windows x64/arm64 | `Swatinem/rust-cache`; job timeouts 15/30/45; diagnostic rerun steps on failure |
| `check-nix.yml` | push/PR dev | Evaluates flake outputs for three systems | 15-minute job timeout |
| `check-docs.yml` | PR with `paths:` | Builds docs, checks links | Path filter, 10-minute timeout |
| `check-bot-scope.yml` | PR, dispatch | Required check: bot branch may change only `nix/hashes.json` | Passes trivially on every other branch |
| `bot-nix-hashes.yml` | push dev with `paths:` | Recomputes Nix hashes, opens an auto-merging PR | Unprivileged compute, privileged publish that runs only `.github/nix-hashes/` |
| `nightly-beta.yml` | cron daily | Dispatches `check-test.yml` on `beta`, full and quarantine | Works around schedules running only on the default branch |
| `release.yml` | push beta, cron every 6 h, dispatch | Plan, verify, tag, build, sign, publish to npm, R2, Docker, Homebrew, AUR, GitHub | Build jobs hold no secrets; sign/publish jobs sparse-checkout `.github/release/` only; OIDC to AWS; digest-verified artifacts; attestations |
| `release-process-daemon.yml` | tag `process-daemon-v*`, PR paths | Builds the PTY daemon for 8 targets, publishes | glibc baseline check; draft then publish; `actions/attest` |
| `deploy.yml`, `deploy-site.yml`, `deploy-files.yml`, `deploy-update.yml` | push dev/production | Cloudflare Worker deploys | Same build/deploy split; 15-minute minted tokens; `checkout@v3.6.0` |
| `triage-pr-standards.yml` | `pull_request_target` | Enforces PR title and template, labels, comments | `github-script`, no checkout |
| `triage-contributor.yml` | `pull_request_target` opened | Adds `contributor` label | None |
| `triage-compliance-close.yml` | cron every 30 min | Closes non-compliant items after 72 h | None |
| `triage-close-issues.yml`, `triage-close-prs.yml` | cron daily | Closes stale issues, and PRs without reactions | `bun-version: latest` |

Branch rules on `dev` (live API):
- Required checks are `unit (linux)`, `typecheck` and `bot-scope`.
- `strict_required_status_checks_policy` is false.
- Merges are squash-only.
- No workflow has a `merge_group` trigger, so there is no merge queue.

## 3. Recommendations, ranked by expected benefit

### 1. Fan the CLI suite out across jobs behind an aggregator (adapt)

- **OpenCode:** `check-test.yml:239-243` defines shard legs (`- id: app-1` / `shard: 1/2`). `:337-355` is an aggregator `e2e (${{ matrix.os }})` with `if: ${{ !cancelled() && ...}}` that runs `test "$AFFECTED" = success && test "$SUITES" = "$EXPECTED"`.
- **nexus today:**
  - `cli/scripts/test_shards.mjs:49` hard-caps shards (`count > 2` throws).
  - `run_tests_driver.mjs:15` runs `concurrency: 1`, so two test processes share a 4-vCPU runner.
  - `ci.yml:103` says "Recent runs take about 32-34 minutes".
  - `cli/scripts/test_durations.json` holds 11 of 427 files, all unit-tier, so balancing falls back to source bytes for the rest.
- **Change:**
  - Lift the cap in `partitionTestFiles` and accept a shard index (`NEXUS_TEST_SHARD_OF=2/4`).
  - In `ci.yml`, add `test-shard` with `matrix: {node: [22, 24], shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]}`.
  - Turn `test-matrix` into an aggregator with the same `node` matrix, so the required names `test-matrix (22)` and `test-matrix (24)` survive.
  - Set `NEXUS_TEST_DURATIONS_OUT` per shard in CI and upload it. `run_tests.mjs:109-114` writes one path per process, so the two in-job shards currently overwrite each other.
- **Effect:** the suite step drops from about 33 minutes towards 9-10 with four legs. This is a linear estimate, not measured. It shortens both the PR run and the mandatory post-merge run, which is the "five PRs take hours" cost.
- **Cost and risk:**
  - Setup repeats per leg.
  - As in OpenCode, the aggregator sees one combined result, so a Node 22 failure also reddens `test-matrix (24)`.
  - Without `!cancelled()` the aggregator is skipped on failure, and a skipped required check counts as passing.
  - `release_workflow_parity.test.ts`, `check_requirements.test.ts:555`, `eval_integrity.test.ts:510` and `verify_action.test.ts:152` assert `ci.yml` text and must change with it.
- **Process conflict:** none; required checks stay meaningful.

### 2. Stop running the suite a third time in `linux-x86_64` (adapt)

- **OpenCode:** build jobs never re-run tests. `release.yml:171-204` builds the CLI once and later jobs download it (`:264-269`). In `check-test.yml`, `build` is separate from `unit`.
- **nexus today:** `ci.yml:179-190` repeats npm ci, build, lint, `cargo test`, the release build and the full suite on Node 22. That is exactly `test-matrix (22)` (`:71-105`), before packaging.
- **Change:** drop the suite and `cargo test` from `linux-x86_64`, keeping the packaging, reproducibility, SBOM and smoke steps.
- **Effect:** about a third fewer runner-minutes per run. It is also a prerequisite for item 1, because otherwise this job stays the 33-minute long pole.
- **Cost and risk:** `release_workflow_parity.test.ts` deliberately asserts that this job runs the suite, and `ci.yml:188` says "Keep release packaging parity". The parity that mattered was `release.yml` against `test-matrix`, which is unaffected. This is an owner decision.

### 3. Add a concurrency group to `ci.yml` (adopt)

- **OpenCode:** `check-test.yml:33` groups by PR number for pull requests and by `run_id` otherwise, with `cancel-in-progress: true`. The comment reads "every push and manual run keeps its own group, so each dev and beta commit gets a verdict".
- **nexus today:** `ci.yml` has no `concurrency` key; `codeql.yml:15-17` does.
- **Change:** copy the idiom so PR runs cancel and release-branch pushes never do.
- **Effect:** each superseded PR push stops burning three jobs of about 35-45 minutes.
- **Risk:** negligible. `case()` is a newer expression function; the `&&`/`||` form works too.

### 4. Point scheduled suites at the release branch (adopt)

- **OpenCode:** `nightly-beta.yml:3` says "GitHub runs schedules only from the default branch", and `:22` runs `gh workflow run check-test.yml --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --ref beta`.
- **nexus today:** `real-project-smoke.yml` (nightly) and `lsp-real-servers.yml` (weekly) check out with no `ref`, so on schedule they test `main`. Development is on `release/v1.3.0`, so the alarms watch frozen code for the whole cycle.
- **Change:** a small dispatcher on `main` with `permissions: actions: write` that resolves the newest `release/v*` branch and dispatches both workflows with `--ref`.
- **Effect:** smoke and LSP regressions surface during the cycle instead of after the merge to `main`.
- **Process conflict:** it needs a workflow-only change on `main` mid-cycle and an `actions: write` token. Both are owner calls.
- **Related, not from OpenCode:** it has no Dependabot or Renovate config. Your Dependabot pain is the same default-branch rule, and the fix is `target-branch:` in the `main` copy of `dependabot.yml`. That copy also still lists `/demo` and `experiments/*`.

### 5. Cache Rust builds, restore on PRs and save only on pushes (adapt)

- **OpenCode:** `check-process-daemon.yml:68` uses `Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb...`, with the note at `:180` "No cache-on-failure: a timed-out run once saved a partial cache that broke re-runs". `setup-bun/action.yml:74` saves only when the event is not a pull request.
- **nexus today:** each job runs clippy, `cargo test` and `cargo build --release` cold (`ci.yml:76-78`, `:184-186`, `:227`). Only `~/.cargo/bin` is cached.
- **Change:** add a pinned rust-cache step for `core -> target` in the test jobs, saving only on push.
- **Effect:** removes most Rust compile time from every job; I could not size it from the files.
- **Risk:** the packaging build runs in the pinned container with its own `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` (`package-linux.sh:45-55`), so reproducibility evidence is untouched. It is one more third-party action to pin.

### 6. Diff against the merge commit's first parent (adopt)

- **OpenCode:** `check.yml:41-43` runs `bun run lint:changed HEAD^1`, "so base-branch commits the pull request has not merged are not counted as its changes (the event's base SHA can predate them)". `check-test.yml:46` does the same.
- **nexus today:** `ci.yml:75`, `:183` and `:232` use `github.event.pull_request.base.sha`.
- **Change:** on pull requests, resolve `HEAD^1` for `NEXUS_FMT_BASE` and diff coverage.
- **Effect:** removes the wrong-base case for the rustfmt gate and diff coverage. It does not fix a stale merge commit, and OpenCode has nothing for that.

### 7. Split `release.yml` into an unprivileged build and a privileged publish (adapt)

- **OpenCode:** `release.yml:5-7` says build jobs "run repository code ... with no environment, secrets or id-token", and sign and publish jobs "check out only .github/release/ ... They never execute repository code". The `upload` and `download` actions tie artifacts together by a SHA256SUMS digest.
- **nexus today:** `release.yml:7-18` gives one job `contents: write`, `id-token: write` and `attestations: write` while it runs `npm ci`, the suite and cargo builds.
- **Change:** a `package` job with `contents: read` uploads `dist` and outputs a digest. A `publish` job verifies the digest, attests and creates the draft or prerelease.
- **Effect:** dependency install scripts and test code no longer run beside a write token and OIDC.
- **Process conflict:** none. The owner still pushes the tag, and stable still stays a draft.

### 8. Smaller hygiene items (adopt)

- Extract the evaluator setup into a composite action. It is copied at `ci.yml:20-59`, `:112-151` and `release.yml:22-83`, which is the drift the rc.12 parity test exists to catch. The parity test greps workflow text and would need to read the action file.
- Add job-level `timeout-minutes`. `ci.yml` only bounds the suite step, so a hung `cargo test` or packaging step can run for six hours.
- Add `persist-credentials: false` to the three checkouts in `ci.yml`.
- Fix `release.yml:105`, which says "12-20 minutes" where `ci.yml:103` says 32-34.

### 9. Quarantine lane (adapt, owner decision)

- **OpenCode:** `QUARANTINE.md` requires "fix a quarantined test or delete it within 14 days". The legs use `continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.quarantine }}` (`check-test.yml:227`) and run nightly.
- **nexus today:** `flake-report.yml` detects flakes but there is nowhere to park one.
- **Assessment:** a documented list run in a non-required leg would stop one known Node 22 ordering race from blocking every merge. It weakens the required checks by definition, so adopt it only with the expiry rule.

### 10. Skip heavy jobs for docs-only changes (adapt, low confidence)

- **OpenCode:** the `affected` job plus an aggregator that expects `skipped` (`check-test.yml:352`).
- **nexus today:** 65 test files under `cli/test` reference `docs/`, `.github/`, `README.md` or `AGENTS.md`, and the doc gates at `ci.yml:60-63` read docs.
- **Assessment:** a skip is only safe for an inventoried subtree that no test reads. Do that inventory first.

### Not applicable, or worse than what nexus has

- **Affected-only tests** (`turbo test --affected`, `check-test.yml:126`): package-graph selection in a monorepo. nexus's CLI is one package, and your recorded failures are cross-cutting ones this would hide.
- **Deferring matrix legs to post-merge:** OpenCode accepts a red `dev` (`check-test.yml:231-232`: Windows legs "still fail on dev pushes often enough"). The jobs run in parallel, so it would not save wall time either.
- **Non-strict checks with no post-merge gate:** this contradicts your "green PR is not a green main" rule.
- **Blacksmith runners:** the PR tier uses 4-vCPU machines, so there is no core gain, and it would change the runner images behind your reproducibility evidence.
- **Merge queue:** OpenCode does not use one. I believe GitHub does not offer it on user-owned repositories; I did not check this.
- **Triage and stale bots, scheduled auto-publish, bot auto-merge:** irrelevant to a single-owner repo, or contrary to release authority.

**Where nexus is already stronger:**
- Every action is SHA-pinned on current majors, and every workflow has a top-level `permissions` block.
- It has CodeQL, `cargo deny`, SBOM validation, byte-reproducibility checks and the cross-runner `repro.yml`.
- It gates on deprecated lockfile entries, tag ancestry and version-only stable diffs.
- It has a flake budget, a per-file watchdog with restart, and a Node matrix on every PR.

OpenCode has none of these in `.github`.

## 4. Risky to copy

- **`pull_request_target` with a write token:** `triage-pr-standards.yml:4` and `triage-contributor.yml:4`. Safe there only because nothing is checked out.
- **Unpinned tooling under a write token:** `bun-version: latest` at `triage-close-issues.yml:19` and `triage-close-prs.yml:31`; `ubuntu-latest` in all five triage workflows and `nightly-beta.yml:16`.
- **Dispatch inputs interpolated into shell:** `triage-close-prs.yml:37`, `:44`, `:46`.
- **No `permissions` block:** `check.yml`, and no top-level block in four of the five triage workflows.
- **Workflow-wide `checks: write` on PR runs:** `check-test.yml:36-38`, with credentials persisted in jobs that run repository code (`:59-62`).
- **Deprecated action:** `actions/checkout@f43a0e5... # v3.6.0` in all four deploy workflows (for example `deploy.yml:37`). `check-test.yml:41` carries the `FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24` workaround. Both conflict with your no-deprecated rule.
- **Automation that pushes and merges:** `nix-hashes/publish.sh:50` force-pushes and `:64` runs `gh pr merge --auto --squash`, under `contents`, `pull-requests` and `actions` write (`bot-nix-hashes.yml:168-171`).
- **Automation that publishes and tags:** `release.yml:21` publishes the dev channel every six hours, and `:138` pushes a version tag with a deploy key. `tag-release.sh:43-48` reuses an existing tag.
- **Known-red legs reported green:** `check-test.yml:227`.
- **Auto-closing PRs by reaction count:** `triage-close-prs.yml:42`.

## 5. Not read or not verified

- **OpenCode files not read:** the remaining `.github/release/*.sh` scripts (`lib.sh`, `cloudflare-token.sh`, the `deploy-*`, `sign-*`, `render-*` scripts and the other `publish-*` scripts), `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*`, the `targets/**` JSON, and `script/github/close-*.ts`. `lint-changed.ts` was read only in part, from the October clone.
- **OpenCode settings not visible:** environment protection rules, the tag ruleset, and whether Turbo remote caching is configured outside the files (none is visible).
- **nexus timings:** I made no GitHub requests about nexus-code, so the 32-34 minute figure comes from the `ci.yml` comment and "25-35 minutes per run" is yours. The 10-minute sharding estimate and the Rust-cache saving are unmeasured.
- **nexus settings:** the required-check configuration is taken from `AGENTS.md`.
- **Wedged runs and stale merge commits:** nothing in OpenCode addresses either. OpenCode's bot relies on dispatched runs satisfying required checks (`publish.sh:58-62`), which your notes say did not work for you; I could not reconcile the two.
